671:    public class AircraftParams
672:    {
673:
674:        public Point3d Loc;
675:        public Vector3d Vwld;
676:        public long time_tick = 0;
677:
678:        public double Z_AltitudeAGL = 0;
679:        public double Z_VelocityMach = 0;
680:        public double Z_VelocityMPH = 0;
681:        public double vel_mps = 0;
682:        public double vel_mph = 0;
683:        public double heading = 0;
684:        public double pitch = 0;
685:        public AiActor actor = null;
686:
687:        public AircraftParams()
688:        {
689:        }
690:
691:        public AircraftParams(Point3d l, Vector3d v, double t = 0, double agl = 0, double vm = 0, double vmps = 0, double vmph = 0, double h = 0, double p = 0, AiActor a = null)
692:        {
693:            Loc = l;
694:            Vwld = v;
695:            time_tick = StatCalcs.TimeSince2016_ticks();
696:            Z_AltitudeAGL = agl;
697:            Z_VelocityMach = vm;
698:            Z_VelocityMPH = vm * 600;
699:            vel_mps = vmps;
700:            vel_mph = vmph;
701:            heading = h;
702:            pitch = p;
703:            actor = a;
704:        }
705:
706:        public AircraftParams(AiActor a)
707:        {
708:            time_tick = StatCalcs.TimeSince2016_ticks();
709:            if (a == null) return;
710:            actor = a;
711:            Loc = actor.Pos();
712:            if ((a as AiAircraft) != null)
713:            {
714:                AiAircraft aircraft = a as AiAircraft;
715:                Z_VelocityMach = aircraft.getParameter(part.ParameterTypes.Z_VelocityMach, 0);
716:                Z_VelocityMPH = Math.Abs(Z_VelocityMach) * 600; //this is an approximation but good enough for our purposes.
717:                                                                //We use Z_VelocityMach because it seems more stable/predictable when passed through onDeadActor and also it is
718:                                                                //unit invariant--it comes back as a % of mach whether we are using English or metric units
719:                                                                //sometimes Z_VelocityMach is negative, which seems to indicate you are going backwards @ that speed.
720:
721:
722:                //double I_VelocityIAS = 0; // aircraft1.getParameter(part.ParameterTypes.I_VelocityIAS, -1);
723:                Z_AltitudeAGL = aircraft.getParameter(part.ParameterTypes.Z_AltitudeAGL, 0);
724:                //double S_GunReserve = aircraft1.getParameter(part.ParameterTypes.S_GunReserve, 0);
725:                //double S_GunClipReserve = aircraft1.getParameter(part.ParameterTypes.S_GunClipReserve, 0);
726:                //double S_GunReserve = 0; aircraft1.getParameter(part.ParameterTypes.S_GunReserve, 0);
727:                //double S_GunClipReserve = 0; aircraft1.getParameter(part.ParameterTypes.S_GunClipReserve, 0);
728:
729:                Vwld = aircraft.AirGroup().Vwld();
730:                vel_mps = StatCalcs.CalculatePointDistance(Vwld);
731:                vel_mph = StatCalcs.meterspsec2milesphour(vel_mps);
732:                heading = (StatCalcs.CalculateBearingDegree(Vwld));
733:                pitch = StatCalcs.CalculatePitchDegree(Vwld);
734:
735:                //So, pitch seems to work well for some aircraft (ie Hurricane) but almost always shows as "0.0" for others (ie Blennie)
736:                //So it seems too unreliable ot use here.  Also vel_mph & other data from Vwld seem unreliable in the case of a
737:                //a crash like this, perhaps for the same reason.  It is perhaps being sampled a bit too late to be of use to us here.
738:
739:
740:                //vel_mps vel_mph heading pitch
741:
742:            }
743:        }
744:
745:
746:        //public override string ToString (string frmt)
747:        public override string ToString()
748:        {
749:            string frmt = "N1";
750:            string ret = "(" + Loc.x.ToString(frmt) + ", "
751:               + Loc.y.ToString(frmt) + ", "
752:               + Loc.z.ToString(frmt) + ") "
753:               + "(" + Vwld.x.ToString(frmt) + ", "
754:               + Vwld.y.ToString(frmt) + ", "
755:               + Vwld.z.ToString(frmt) + ") "
756:               + "Time: " + time_tick.ToString()
757:               + " Alt: " + Z_AltitudeAGL.ToString(frmt)
758:               + " Vel_mps: " + vel_mps.ToString(frmt)
759:               + " Vel_mph: " + vel_mph.ToString(frmt)
760:               + " heading: " + heading.ToString(frmt)
761:               + " pitch: " + pitch.ToString(frmt);
762:
763:            if (actor != null && actor.Name() != null) ret += " actor: " + actor.Name();
764:            return ret;
765:        }
766:    }

811:    static object StbAircraftParamStack_locker = new object();
812:    //Save aircraft state for players periodically & save the last few seconds data, so that when something happens (ie crash, landing,
813:    //whatever) we have some idea of what was going on just before that
814:    public class StbAircraftParamStack
815:    {
816:
817:        Dictionary<string, CircularArray<AircraftParams>> aircraftParams = new Dictionary<string, CircularArray<AircraftParams>>();
818:        int recursInterval = 203; //time between saving params
819:        int array_size = 6; //Number of param sets to save on the stack, for each player/aircraft
820:        public int paramsInstance = 0;
821:        StatsMission mission;
822:        public System.Threading.Timer timer;
823:
824:        public StbAircraftParamStack(StatsMission m)
825:        {
826:            mission = m;
827:            /*timer = new Timer(200);
828:            timer.Elapsed += saveAircraftParams_recurs();
829:            timer.Start();            */
830:            startTimer();
831:
832:
833:        }
834:        public void startTimer()
835:        {
836:            disposeTimer();
837:            timer = new System.Threading.Timer(
838:                new TimerCallback(saveAircraftParams_recurs),
839:                null,
840:                33000, //wait time @ startup, in ms
841:                recursInterval); //periodically call the callback at this interval
842:            //saveAircraftParams_recurs(paramsInstance);            
843:        }
844:        public void disposeTimer()
845:        {
846:            if (timer != null) timer.Dispose();
847:        }
848:
849:        private void addParams(Player player)
850:        {
851:
852:            if (player.Place() == null || player.Name() == null) return;
853:
854:            CircularArray<AircraftParams> apa = new CircularArray<AircraftParams>(array_size);
855:
856:            if (!aircraftParams.TryGetValue(player.Name(), out apa)) apa = new CircularArray<AircraftParams>(array_size);
857:
858:            AircraftParams ap = new AircraftParams(player.Place());
859:
860:            //if (mission.stb_Debug) Console.WriteLine("addParams: " + ap.ToString());
861:
862:            apa.Push(ap);
863:
864:            aircraftParams[player.Name()] = apa;
865:
866:        }
867:
868:        //returns the player's paramstack as an array (and as a stack, ie latest params are index 0, index 1 is before that, etc)
869:        public AircraftParams[] returnParamsArray(Player player)
870:        {
871:
872:            CircularArray<AircraftParams> apa = new CircularArray<AircraftParams>(array_size);
873:
874:            if (!aircraftParams.TryGetValue(player.Name(), out apa)) apa = new CircularArray<AircraftParams>(array_size);
875:
876:            return apa.ArrayStack;
877:
878:        }
879:
880:        //figures the max/min of a few key values over the life of the params - steepest pitch, highest downward/z velocity, highest speed, etc
881:        public AircraftParams returnMaxes(Player player)
882:        {
883:
884:            CircularArray<AircraftParams> apa = new CircularArray<AircraftParams>(array_size);
885:
886:            if (!aircraftParams.TryGetValue(player.Name(), out apa))
887:            {
888:                //apa = new CircularArray<AircraftParams>(array_size);
889:                Console.WriteLine("apMax Calc: Player {0} record/params not found ", player.Name());
890:                return new AircraftParams();
891:            }
892:
893:            AircraftParams apMax = new AircraftParams();
894:            AircraftParams ap2ndToMax = new AircraftParams();
895:            bool starting = true;
896:
897:            //return apa.ArrayStack;
898:            foreach (AircraftParams ap in apa.ArrayStack)
899:            {
900:
901:                //if (starting || ap.Vwld.z < apMax.Vwld.z) apMax.Vwld = ap.Vwld;  //Gets Vwld @ moment of max downward velocity 
902:                if (starting || apMax.Vwld.z >= 0)  //2020-03-22: corrected <=0 to >=0, because downward vertical velocity should be <= 0 ?
903:                {
904:                    apMax.Vwld = ap.Vwld;  //Gets Vwld.z just before hitting ground (ie Vwld.z = 0 or greater)
905:                    apMax.vel_mph = ap.vel_mph; //also gets the overall velocity at this moment--the moment just before impact w/ the ground
906:                                                //if we didn't hit the ground (say, Vwld.z is always 0 or greater) then we must have hit into something as we were flying or rolling across the ground.  In that case we get the first value on the stack which is OK--this is the speed etc just before impact.
907:
908:
909:                }
910:                //if (starting || ap.vel_mph > apMax.vel_mph) apMax.vel_mph = ap.vel_mph;  //Gets largest vel_mph
911:                if (apMax.vel_mph <= 0 && ap.vel_mph > 0) apMax.vel_mph = ap.vel_mph;  //One exception--if the vel we pick up @ moment of impact is zero then we'll replace it with the previous one, if that is larger
912:                                                                                       //if (starting || ap.pitch < apMax.pitch) apMax.pitch = ap.pitch;  //Gets smallest pitch (ie, most negative)
913:                if (starting || apMax.pitch <= 0) apMax.pitch = ap.pitch;  //Similarly, gets pitch just before hitting ground, ie, just before pitch goes 0 or positive
914:                if (starting) apMax.actor = ap.actor;
915:                if (starting) ap2ndToMax = apMax;
916:
917:                starting = false;
918:
919:                try
920:                {
921:                    Console.WriteLine("apMax Calc: ver: {0:F1} vel: {1:F1} pitch: {2:F1} tick: {3}", ap.Vwld.z, ap.vel_mph, ap.pitch, ap.time_tick);
922:                }
923:                catch (Exception ex) { Console.WriteLine("apMAX error1: " + ex.ToString()); }
924:
925:
926:            }
927:            try
928:            {
929:                Console.WriteLine("apMax Ret: ver: {0:F1} vel: {1:F1} pitch: {2:F1} currtick: {3}", apMax.Vwld.z, apMax.vel_mph, apMax.pitch, StatCalcs.TimeSince2016_ticks());
930:            }
931:            catch (Exception ex) { Console.WriteLine("apMAX error2: " + ex.ToString()); }
932:
933:            return apMax;
934:
935:        }
936:        //Tries to take a "safe average" of any "death" parameters to (perhaps!?) avoid game glitches while still catching actual deaths/crashes
937:        //skips the first one back if it's zero, then takes average of next two readings.
938:        public AircraftParams returnSafeMaxAverage(Player player)
939:        {
940:
941:            CircularArray<AircraftParams> apa = new CircularArray<AircraftParams>(array_size);
942:
943:            if (!aircraftParams.TryGetValue(player.Name(), out apa))
944:            {
945:                //apa = new CircularArray<AircraftParams>(array_size);
946:                return new AircraftParams();
947:            }
948:
949:            AircraftParams apAve = new AircraftParams();
950:            //AircraftParams ap2ndToMax = new AircraftParams();
951:            bool starting = true;
952:
953:            //return apa.ArrayStack;
954:            foreach (AircraftParams ap in apa.ArrayStack)
955:            {
956:
957:                //if (starting || ap.Vwld.z < apMax.Vwld.z) apMax.Vwld = ap.Vwld;  //Gets Vwld @ moment of max downward velocity 
958:                if (starting)
959:                {
960:                    if (ap.Vwld.z == 0 && ap.vel_mph == 0) //So if the most recent params is vert/hor velocity zero, we skip it. This will skip the one reading where the aircraft crashed & then stopped.
961:                    {
962:                        starting = false;
963:                        continue;
964:                    }
965:                    apAve = ap;
966:                    starting = false;
967:                    continue;
968:                }
969:                //if (starting || ap.vel_mph > apMax.vel_mph) apMax.vel_mph = ap.vel_mph;  //Gets largest vel_mph
970:
971:                apAve.Vwld.z = (apAve.Vwld.z + ap.Vwld.z) / 2;
972:                apAve.vel_mph = (apAve.vel_mph = ap.vel_mph) / 2;
973:                apAve.pitch = (apAve.pitch + ap.pitch) / 2;
974:
975:                try
976:                {
977:                    Console.WriteLine("apAve Calc: ver: {0:F1} vel: {1:F1} pitch: {2:F1}", ap.Vwld.z, ap.vel_mph, ap.pitch);
978:                    Console.WriteLine("apAve Ret: ver: {0:F1} vel: {1:F1} pitch: {2:F1}", apAve.Vwld.z, apAve.vel_mph, apAve.pitch);
979:                }
980:                catch (Exception ex) { Console.WriteLine("apMAX error3: " + ex.ToString()); }
981:
982:                return apAve;  //just average the first two (or one, if only one) back, and/or 2nd-3rd if the 1st back is a full stop, and return that.
983:
984:
985:            }
986:            try
987:            {
988:                Console.WriteLine("apAve Ret: ver: {0:F1} vel: {1:F1} pitch: {2:F1}", apAve.Vwld.z, apAve.vel_mph, apAve.pitch);
989:            }
990:            catch (Exception ex) { Console.WriteLine("apMAX error4: " + ex.ToString()); }
991:            return apAve;
992:
993:        }

995:        //Decides if this player's data is glitchy.  We're saying glitchy is, all readings 0 except for 1.
996:        //If glitchy, we might ignore this data.
997:        //ret -1 if no glitch, otherwise position of glitchy entry
998:        public int GlitchWarning(Player player)
999:        {
1000:
1001:            CircularArray<AircraftParams> apa = new CircularArray<AircraftParams>(array_size);
1002:
1003:            if (!aircraftParams.TryGetValue(player.Name(), out apa))
1004:            {
1005:                return -1;
1006:            }
1007:
1008:
1009:            AircraftParams apAve = new AircraftParams();
1010:            //AircraftParams ap2ndToMax = new AircraftParams();
1011:            bool starting = true;
1012:
1013:            int inc = 0;
1014:            int glitchCount = 0;
1015:            int numGlitch = -1;
1016:
1017:            long currTime_ticks = StatCalcs.TimeSince2016_ticks();
1018:            long staleTime_tick = TimeSpan.TicksPerSecond * 5; //calling the data stale after 5 seconds
1019:
1020:            //return apa.ArrayStack;
1021:            foreach (AircraftParams ap in apa.ArrayStack)
1022:            {
1023:                long timeDiff_tick = Math.Abs(currTime_ticks - ap.time_tick);
1024:                try
1025:                {
1026:                    Console.WriteLine("apGlitchNumber: {0:F1} glitchCount: {1:F1} number of Glitch: {2:F1} timeDiff: {3:F2}", inc, glitchCount, numGlitch, timeDiff_tick / TimeSpan.TicksPerSecond);
1027:                }
1028:                catch (Exception ex)
1029:                {
1030:                    Console.WriteLine("apMAX error5A: " + ex.ToString());
1031:                }
1032:
1033:                if (timeDiff_tick > staleTime_tick)
1034:                {
1035:                    numGlitch = inc;
1036:                    Console.WriteLine("apGlitchTimeDiff: {0:F2} seconds ", timeDiff_tick / TimeSpan.TicksPerSecond);
1037:                    break;
1038:                }
1039:                if (ap.Vwld.z != 0 && ap.vel_mph != 0)
1040:                {
1041:                    glitchCount++; //So if the most recent params is vert/hor velocity zero, we skip it. This will skip the one reading where the aircraft crashed & then stopped.
1042:                    numGlitch = inc;
1043:                }
1044:                inc++;
1045:
1046:            }
1047:            try
1048:            {
1049:                Console.WriteLine("apGlitchWarning: number: {0:F1} glitchCount: {1:F1} number of Glitch: {2:F1}", inc, glitchCount, numGlitch);
1050:            }
1051:            catch (Exception ex) { Console.WriteLine("apMAX error5: " + ex.ToString()); }
1052:
1053:            if (glitchCount == 1)
1054:            {
1055:                return numGlitch;
1056:            }
1057:            else
1058:            {
1059:                return -1;
1060:            }
1061:
1062:        }

1335:        //Saves by Player. If the stats dictionary entry for that player doesn't yet exist, it is created.
1336:        public Stb_PlayerSessStat StbSis_Save(Player player)
1337:        {
1338:            if (player != null && player.Name() != null && player.Name().Length > 0)
1339:            {
1340:                //Console.WriteLine("statplayer: " + player.Name() + player.Army().ToString());
1341:
1342:                var OldStats = new Stb_PlayerSessStat(mission);
1343:
1344:                if (!stbSis_saveIPlayerStat.TryGetValue(player.Name(), out OldStats))
1345:                {
1346:                    OldStats = new Stb_PlayerSessStat(mission);
1347:                } //See explanation for this idiom under StbSr_UpdateStatsForMission
1348:
1349:                if (player is IPlayer)
1350:                {
1351:                    IPlayerStat CurrStats = (player as IPlayer).GetBattleStat() as IPlayerStat;
1352:                    StbSis_WriteDiff(player as Player, OldStats, CurrStats);
1353:                    OldStats.Set(CurrStats);
1354:                }
1355:                else //in case this is a 'blank' player who is not logged into the game at the moment; we just have their name & army
1356:                     //in this case we don't need to WriteDiff because their stats are zero.  But we need to initialize their OldStats to zero for everything
1357:                {
1358:                    OldStats.Set(player);
1359:                }
1360:                stbSis_saveIPlayerStat[player.Name()] = OldStats;  //now that we have updated the Mission stats with any new/updated values in PlayerStat, we update the PlayerStat to the current values, so we can rinse & repeat next time around.
1361:
1362:                //if (stbSis_LogErrors) 
1363:                //Console.WriteLine("Stats for " + player.Name() + ": " + OldStats.ToString());
1364:
1365:                //               player.Name(), st.landings, st.kills, st.fkills, st.gkills[0], st.fgkills[0], st.deaths, st.bails, st.ditches, st.planeChanges, st.planesWrittenOff, M_Health, M_CabinState, M_SystemWear, cdam, ndam, st.bombsFire, st.bombsHit, st.bombsWeight, st.bulletsFire, st.bulletsHit, st.bulletsHitAir, GetDictionary(st.killsTypes), GetDictionary(st.tTotalTypes), st.gkills[1], st.gkills[2], st.gkills[3]));

1367:                return OldStats; //OldStats is actually now current, so return it in case it is wanted.

1372:        private void StbSis_WriteDiff(Player player, Stb_PlayerSessStat OldStats, IPlayerStat CurrStats)
1373:        {
1374:
1375:            //Console.WriteLine("Writing DIFF {0}", player.Name());
1376:            StbSis_AddToMissionStat(player, 835, (int)(Math.Round((CurrStats.kills - OldStats.kills) * 100)));
1377:            //StbSis_AddToMissionStat(player, 835, (CurrStats.kills - OldStats.kills) * 100);
1378:            StbSis_AddToMissionStat(player, 836, (int)(Math.Round((CurrStats.fkills - OldStats.fkills) * 100)));
1379:            StbSis_AddToMissionStat(player, 837, CurrStats.bulletsFire - OldStats.bulletsFire);
1380:            StbSis_AddToMissionStat(player, 838, CurrStats.bulletsHit - OldStats.bulletsHit);
1381:            StbSis_AddToMissionStat(player, 839, CurrStats.bulletsHitAir - OldStats.bulletsHitAir);
1382:            StbSis_AddToMissionStat(player, 840, CurrStats.bombsFire - OldStats.bombsFire);
1383:            StbSis_AddToMissionStat(player, 841, CurrStats.bombsHit - OldStats.bombsHit);
1384:
1385:            double bombsOnTarget_kg = 0;
1386:            if ((CurrStats.bombsFire - OldStats.bombsFire) > 0) bombsOnTarget_kg = (double)(CurrStats.bombsHit - OldStats.bombsHit) / (double)(CurrStats.bombsFire - OldStats.bombsFire) * (CurrStats.bombsWeight - OldStats.bombsWeight); //This is an approximation is which is exact if all bombs deployed were of the same weight, and our best guess of KG on target if the various bombs were of varying weights.  If bombs were of varying weights, we just don't have the info here about which of them were the ones that hit & which missed.
1387:
1388:
1389:            StbSis_AddToMissionStat(player, 842, (int)(Math.Round(bombsOnTarget_kg)));
1390:
1391:            //We do 'writeDiff' for CloD generated stats where we need to occasionally 'write the difference' to figure out what happened in the CloD stats and save the changes for this session.
1392:            //But for 845 we are generating this stat directly so can just save it directly using StbSis_AddSessStat so we don't need to ALSO do the writeDiff
1393:            //StbSis_AddToMissionStat(player, 845, CurrStats.planesWrittenOff - OldStats.planesWrittenOff);  //Note that this is the TWC 'corrected' planes written off stat (845) NOT the raw Netstats planes written off (843)
1394:
1395:            //gkills=Ips.gkills;
1396:            //fgkillIps.fgkills;
1397:
1398:            //player = Ips.player;
1399:
1400:

1928:        public bool StbCmr_OnTookOff(string playerName, AiActor actor = null)
1929:        {
1930:            try
1931:            {
1932:                //if ((actor as AiAircraft).IsAirborne()) check if plane is airborn
1933:                bool continueMission = true;
1934:                StbContinueMission cm = new StbContinueMission();
1935:                cm.alive = false;
1936:                cm.mayContinue = false;
1937:
1938:                bool ret;
1939:                ret = stbCmr_ContinueMissionInfo.TryGetValue(playerName, out cm);
1940:                if (!ret) cm = new StbContinueMission(); //on unsuccessful trygetvalue cm comes out as "not an object"            
1941:                                                         //If the player died since last take off OR doesn't have 
1942:                                                         //'maycontinue' permission from the last placeEnter
1943:                                                         //then this is a New Mission & we increment the new mission counter
1944:                                                         //Otherwise, this is a continuation of a mission & we skip incrementing the mission counter            
1945:                cm.posEnterActor = actor;
1946:                if (!cm.alive || !cm.mayContinue)
1947:                {
1948:                    //StbStatTask sst1 = new StbStatTask(StbStatCommands.Mission, playerName, new int[] { 779 });
1949:                    //outer.stb_StatRecorder.StbSr_EnqueueTask(sst1);
1950:                    continueMission = false;
1951:                }
1952:
1953:
1954:                //OK, we were resetin loc.x & loc.y to -1000000 on take off, just as a belt 'n suspenders thing, but actually having the real location is quite useful when we are trying to detect whether (eg bomber pilot) place enters are new sorties or just switching around within one single sortie.  So we will save the .pos when possible
1955:                if (actor != null)
1956:                {
1957:                    cm.placeLeaveLoc.x = actor.Pos().x;
1958:                    cm.placeLeaveLoc.y = actor.Pos().y;
1959:                }
1960:                else
1961:                {
1962:                    cm.placeLeaveLoc.x = -1000000;
1963:                    cm.placeLeaveLoc.y = -1000000;
1964:                }
1965:
1966:
1967:                //This is the moment we reset alive & may continue & damagedsincetakeoff & damagedonlybyself & selfdamage this flight 
1968:                //ie, successful takeoff is where the player actually
1969:                //becomes 'alive' for stats & continueMission purposes
1970:
1971:                cm.alive = true;
1972:                cm.mayContinue = true;
1973:
1974:                cm.flightStartTime_sec = StatCalcs.TimeSince2016_sec();
1975:                Console.WriteLine("StbCmr_OnTookOff: Reseting flightstarttime_sec because just took off.");
1976:
1977:                //we don't reset these here, but in StbCmr_SavePositionEnter, because we want to capture any self-damage on taxi & takeoff 
1978:                //cm.damagedSinceTakeoff=false; //Between these two we can figure out if the only
1979:                //cm.damagedOnlyBySelf=true;  //damage upon landing or de-spawning is self-inflicted
1980:                //cm.selfDamageThisFlight=0;
1981:
1982:                stbCmr_ContinueMissionInfo[playerName] = cm;
1983:
1984:                //Console.WriteLine( "TookOff: " + playerName                   + " Mission Continuing: "                   + continueMission.ToString() + " " + cm.ToString("F0"));                                            
1985:
1986:                return continueMission;
1987:            }
1988:            catch (Exception ex) { StbCmr_PrepareErrorMessage(ex); return false; }

2078:        public void StbCmr_UpdateSelfDamage(string playerName = "", bool thisIsSelfDamage = false)
2079:        {
2080:            try
2081:            {
2082:                bool prevDamage = false;
2083:                if (playerName != null)
2084:                {
2085:
2086:                    StbContinueMission cm = new StbContinueMission();
2087:                    if (stbCmr_ContinueMissionInfo.TryGetValue(playerName, out cm))
2088:                    { //Ok the person has newly spawned in and was previously flying, we check to see if 1. the person has died since last takeoff and 2. mayContinue is true (mayContinue is a signal from the previous event, the positionLeave in this case, that it was Ok to continue the mission @ that point). 3. Is taking off from the same place they recently landed.  If haven't died, mayContinue is true & taking off from same place, within 2000 of the place where they left their previous plane/position, they can continue the mission.                                                  
2089:
2090:                        prevDamage = cm.damagedSinceTakeoff;
2091:                        cm.damagedSinceTakeoff = true; //Between these two we can figure out if the only damage upon landing or de-spawning is self-inflicted
2092:                        cm.damagedOnlyBySelf = (cm.damagedOnlyBySelf && thisIsSelfDamage);  //if even one hit of non-self-damage is received, set this to false
2093:                        cm.selfDamageThisFlight++; //we track how many times the self-damage happens  
2094:
2095:
2096:                    }
2097:                    else
2098:                    {//in case the player record doesn't exist yet; shouldn't happen too often
2099:                        prevDamage = false;
2100:                        cm = new StbContinueMission();
2101:                        cm.placeLeaveLoc.x = -1000000;
2102:                        cm.placeLeaveLoc.y = -1000000;
2103:                        cm.alive = true;
2104:                        cm.mayContinue = false;
2105:                        cm.damagedSinceTakeoff = true; //Between these two we can figure out if the only damage upon landing or de-spawning is self-inflicted
2106:                        cm.damagedOnlyBySelf = (thisIsSelfDamage);  //if even one hit of non-self-damage is received, set this to false.  Initially we can set it to the value of this damage hit.
2107:                        cm.selfDamageThisFlight = 1;
2108:                        cm.flightStartTime_sec = StatCalcs.TimeSince2016_sec();
2109:                        Console.WriteLine("StbCmr_UpdateSelfDamage: Reseting flightstarttime_sec because continuemissionrecorder record in DB yet.");
2110:
2111:                    }
2112:                    stbCmr_ContinueMissionInfo[playerName] = cm;
2113:                    StatsMission.StbStatTask sst = new StatsMission.StbStatTask(StatsMission.StbStatCommands.Mission, playerName, new int[] { 790 });
2114:                    this.mission.stb_StatRecorder.StbSr_EnqueueTask(sst);
2115:
2116:                    //Console.WriteLine( "UpdSelfDamage: " + playerName + " " + cm.ToString("F0"));     
2117:                    if (thisIsSelfDamage && !prevDamage) this.mission.Stb_Message(null, this.mission.stb_StatRecorder.StbSr_RankFromName(playerName) + this.mission.stb_StatRecorder.StbSr_MassagePlayername(playerName) + " just damaged own aircraft", new object[] { });  //Display this message TO EVERYONE but only if it is the plane's initial damage since takeoff (to avoid having it display numerous times in case of, for example, a self-crash)

2123:        public bool StbCmr_IsSelfDamage(AiAircraft aircraft = null, AiDamageInitiator initiator = null)
2124:        {
2125:            string msg = "is damaged by ";
2126:            bool thisIsSelfDamage = false;  //we start off by assuming this is true & then check each place in the a/c and set it to false if we find the damageinitiator in one of the places
2127:
2128:            if (aircraft != null)
2129:            {
2130:                if (initiator != null && initiator.Player != null && initiator.Player.Name() != null)
2131:                {
2132:
2133:                    msg += initiator.Player.Name();
2134:                    for (int i = 0; i < aircraft.Places(); i++) //check each place in the a/c etc
2135:                    {
2136:                        if (aircraft.Player(i) is Player && aircraft.Player(i) != null && aircraft.Player(i).Name() != null)
2137:                        {
2138:                            if (aircraft.Player(i).Name() == initiator.Player.Name()) thisIsSelfDamage = true;
2139:                            msg = aircraft.Player(i).Name() + " " + msg;
2140:                        }
2141:                    }
2142:
2143:                }
2144:                else
2145:                {
2146:                    // initiator is null or has no player, which usually means ai. So that means that the player has received damage from someone besides self. 
2147:                    msg += "nobody/AI  ";
2148:                    thisIsSelfDamage = false;
2149:                }
2150:
2151:                if (!thisIsSelfDamage)
2152:                { //this means that the damage initiator is not any of the pilots/operates of the actor.  So we can go ahead & say that this a/c has received some damage that is not self damage                 
2153:                    msg += "nobody/AI  ";
2154:                }
2155:
2156:                for (int i = 0; i < aircraft.Places(); i++)
2157:                {
2158:                    if (aircraft.Player(i) is Player && aircraft.Player(i) != null && aircraft.Player(i).Name() != null)
2159:                    {
2160:                        StbCmr_UpdateSelfDamage(aircraft.Player(i).Name(), thisIsSelfDamage);  //record that fact that the a/c received damage and also whether or not it was self damage                        
2161:                    }
2162:                }
2163:
2164:
2165:            }
2166:            //StbCmr_LogError(msg);            
2167:            return thisIsSelfDamage;
2168:
2169:            //TODO: We could do this for other actor types besides aircraft, too, though not sure why it would be needed   
2170:        }

2294:        try
2295:        {
2296:            AiAircraft aircraft = actor as AiAircraft;
2297:            if (aircraft == null) { return; }
2298:            if (aircraft.Type() == AircraftType.Fighter || aircraft.Type() == AircraftType.HeavyFighter)
2299:            {
2300:                if (aircraft.CrewFunctionPlace(pIndex) == CrewFunction.Pilot)
2301:                {
2302:                    if (p.Army() == 1) { stb_RedFighters += entered ? 1 : -1; return; }
2303:                    if (p.Army() == 2) { stb_BlueFighters += entered ? 1 : -1; return; }
2304:                }
2305:            }
2306:        }
2307:        catch (Exception ex) { Stb_PrepareErrorMessage(ex); }
2308:    }
2309:
2310:    private bool Stb_BalanceCheckForBan(Player p, AiActor actor, int placeIndex)
2311:    {
2312:        try
2313:        {
2314:            stb_Ratio = (stb_RedFighters > stb_BlueFighters) ?
2315:                ((double)stb_RedFighters / (double)stb_BlueFighters) : ((double)stb_BlueFighters / (double)stb_RedFighters);
2316:            stb_Delta = (stb_RedFighters > stb_BlueFighters) ?
2317:                (stb_RedFighters - stb_BlueFighters) : (stb_BlueFighters - stb_RedFighters);
2318:            if (stb_BalanceFightersByRatio)
2319:            {
2320:                if (stb_Ratio > stb_DesiredRatio &&
2321:                    (stb_RedFighters + stb_BlueFighters) > stb_MinCountForBalance)
2322:                {
2323:                    Stb_BalanceMessageForBan(p, actor, placeIndex); return true;
2324:                }
2325:            }
2326:            else
2327:            {
2328:                if (stb_Delta > stb_DesiredDelta &&
2329:                    (stb_RedFighters + stb_BlueFighters) > stb_MinCountForBalance)
2330:                {
2331:                    Stb_BalanceMessageForBan(p, actor, placeIndex); return true;
2332:                }
2333:            }
2334:            return false;
2335:        }
2336:        catch (Exception ex) { Stb_PrepareErrorMessage(ex); return false; }
2337:    }
2338:
2339:    private void Stb_BalanceMessageForBan(Player p, AiActor actor, int placeIndex)
2340:    {
2341:        try
2342:        {
2343:            GamePlay.gpLogServerBegin(new Player[] { p }, stb_BalanceMsgRus);
2344:            GamePlay.gpLogServerEnd();
2345:            GamePlay.gpLogServerBegin(new Player[] { p }, stb_BalanceMsgEng);
2346:            GamePlay.gpLogServerEnd();
2347:            GamePlay.gpHUDLogCenter(new Player[] { p }, stb_BalanceMsgHud);
2348:            Stb_BalanceDisableForBan(actor);
2349:        }
2350:        catch (Exception ex) { Stb_PrepareErrorMessage(ex); }
2351:    }
2352:
2353:    private void Stb_BalanceDisableForBan(AiActor actor)
2354:    {
2355:        try
2356:        {
2357:            AiAircraft aircraft = actor as AiAircraft;
2358:            if (aircraft != null)
2359:            {
2360:                Stb_DamagePlane(aircraft, NamedDamageTypes.ControlsElevatorDisabled);
2361:                Stb_DamagePlane(aircraft, NamedDamageTypes.ControlsAileronsDisabled);
2362:                Stb_DamagePlane(aircraft, NamedDamageTypes.ControlsRudderDisabled);
2363:                Stb_DamagePlane(aircraft, NamedDamageTypes.Eng0TotalSeizure);
2364:                AiAirGroup aag = aircraft.AirGroup();
2365:                if (aag != null)
2366:                {
2367:                    if (aag.aircraftEnginesNum() == 2) { Stb_DamagePlane(aircraft, NamedDamageTypes.Eng1TotalSeizure); }
2368:                }
2369:            }
2370:        }
2371:        catch (Exception ex) { Stb_PrepareErrorMessage(ex); }
2372:    }

3593:    //wrapper for Gameplay.GPLogServer so that we can do things to it, like log it, suppress all output, delay successive messages etc.
3594:    public void gpLogServerAndLog(Player[] to, object data, object[] third = null)
3595:    {
3596:        //this is already logged to logs.txt so no need for this: if (LOG) logToFile (data, LOG_FULL_PATH);
3597:        //gpLogServerWithDelay(to, (string)data, third);
3598:
3599:        //gplogserver chokes on long chat messages, so we will break them up into chunks . . . 
3600:        string str = (string)data;
3601:        int maxChunkSize = 200;
3602:		
3603:		//object vars = third as object;
3604:		string st = data as string;		
3605:		
3606:		//Will send all logmessages going to everyone, to the Tacview recorder
3607:		if (to == null && (mainmission.tacviewimplmission != null))  mainmission.tacviewimplmission.AddBookmark(String.Format(st, third));
3608:
3609:        IEnumerable<string> lines = StatCalcs.SplitToLines(str, maxChunkSize);
3610:        //for (int i = 0; i < str.Length; i += maxChunkSize)
3611:        //for (int i=0; i<lines.GetLength(); i++) gpLogServerWithDelay(to, lines[i], third);
3612:
3613:        foreach (string line in lines) gpLogServerWithDelay(to, line, third);
3614:
3615:
3616:    }
3617:    //This is designed to space out gplogserver calls, as (say) 5-10 of these in a row will cause a very noticeable stutter
3618:    //It's sort of a stack for gplogserver messages
3619:    public void gpLogServerWithDelay(Player[] to, object data, object[] third = null)
3620:    {
3621:        if (GamePlay == null) return; //nothing to do
3622:        //defined above:
3623:        //public Int64 lastGpLogServerMsg_tick = 0;
3624:        //public Int64 GpLogServerMsgDelay_tick = 1000000; //1 mill ticks or 0.1 second
3625:        //public Int64 GpLogServerMsgOffset_tick = 500000; //Different modules or submissions can use a different offset to preclude sending gplogservermessages @ the same moment; 500K ticks or 0.05 second
3626:        DateTime currentDate = DateTime.Now;
3627:        //currentDate.Ticks
3628:        Int64 nextMsg_tick = Math.Max(currentDate.Ticks, lastGpLogServerMsg_tick + GpLogServerMsgDelay_tick);
3629:        Int64 remainder;
3630:        Int64 roundTo = 1000000; //round nextMsg_tick UP to the next 1/10 second.  This is to allow different missions/modules to output at different portions of the 0.1 second interval, with the objective of avoiding stutters when messages from different .mis files or modules pile up
3631:        nextMsg_tick = (Math.DivRem(nextMsg_tick - 1, roundTo, out remainder) + 1) * roundTo; // -1 handles the specific but common situation where we want a 0.1 sec delay but it always rounds it up to 0.2 sec.  This makes it round up for anything greater than roundTo, rather than greater than OR EQUAL TO roundTo.
3632:        double nextMsgDelay_sec = (double)(nextMsg_tick - currentDate.Ticks) / 10000000;
3633:        //string msg = (string)data + "(Delayed: " + nextMsgDelay_sec.ToString("0.00") + ")"; //for testing
3634:        string msg = (string)data;
3635:        //GamePlay.gpLogServer(null, nextMsg_tick.ToString() + " " + nextMsgDelay_sec.ToString("0.00"), null); //for debugging
3636:        Timeout(nextMsgDelay_sec, () => { GamePlay.gpLogServer(to, msg, third); });
3637:        lastGpLogServerMsg_tick = nextMsg_tick; //Save the time_tick that this message will be displayed; next message will be at least GpLogServerMsgDelay_tick after this
3638:
3639:    }

3662:    public bool Stb_isAiControlledPlane(AiAircraft aircraft)
3663:    {
3664:        try
3665:        {
3666:
3667:            if (aircraft == null)
3668:                return false;
3669:
3670:            //check if a player is in any of the "places"
3671:            for (int i = 0; i < aircraft.Places(); i++)
3672:                if (aircraft.Player(i) != null)
3673:                    return false;
3674:
3675:            return true;
3676:        }
3677:        catch (Exception ex) { Stb_PrepareErrorMessage(ex); return false; }
3678:    }
3679:
3680:    //Makes sure no other players are in the a/c except for the given player
3681:    //Note: does not actually check to make sure this player is also in the a/c.  OnPlaceLeave etc the player might be gone already
3682:    //but we really need to make sure NO ONE ELSE is in there at this point, and the player is not still in TWO positions rather than one or zero.
3683:    public bool Stb_isLastPlayerInAircraftandOneOrNoPositions(AiAircraft aircraft, Player player)
3684:    {
3685:        try
3686:        {
3687:
3688:
3689:            if (aircraft == null)
3690:                return false;
3691:            int count = 0;
3692:            for (int i = 0; i < aircraft.Places(); i++)
3693:            {
3694:                if (aircraft.Player(i) == null)
3695:                {
3696:                    count++;
3697:                    continue;
3698:                }
3699:                if (aircraft.Player(i) != player)
3700:                    return false;
3701:            }
3702:
3703:            //When player is fully leaving plane this often looks like -1,-1 onPlaceLeave.  But also often 2,-1, 0,-1, etc.  Only commonality seems to be   Other possibilities if leaving only one position or switching
3704:            //within the aircraft etc are 0,1 0,-1 -1,1 0,1 0,2 etc.  But -1,-1 seems reliable as far as this person as left the plane entirely.
3705:            if (player.PlacePrimary() != null && player.PlaceSecondary() != null && (player.PlacePrimary() == -1 || player.PlaceSecondary() == -1)) return true;
3706:            if (aircraft.Places() == count) return true; //Case of NO live players left in plane
3707:            return false;
3708:
3709:
3710:        }
3711:        catch (Exception ex) { Stb_PrepareErrorMessage(ex); return false; }
3712:    }

3714:    //true if player is one & only player in a/c, false if more than the player in a/c, NULL in case of AI-controlled aircraft (no players)s
3715:    public bool? Stb_isOnlyPlayerInAircraft(AiAircraft aircraft, Player player)
3716:    {
3717:        try
3718:        {
3719:
3720:
3721:            if (aircraft == null)
3722:                return null;
3723:            int count = 0;
3724:            for (int i = 0; i < aircraft.Places(); i++)
3725:            {
3726:                if (aircraft.Player(i) == null)
3727:                {
3728:                    count++;
3729:                    continue;
3730:                }
3731:                if (aircraft.Player(i) != player)
3732:                    return false;
3733:            }
3734:
3735:            if (aircraft.Places() == count) return null; //Case of NO live players in plane, ie, ai-controlled aircraft
3736:            return true;
3737:

3908:    private void Stb_DestroyPlaneSafe(AiAircraft aircraft, string reason="Stb_DestroyPlaneSafe")
3909:    {
3910:        try
3911:        {
3912:            if (aircraft == null) { return; }
3913:            for (int place = 0; place < aircraft.Places(); place++)
3914:            {
3915:                if (aircraft.Player(place) != null) { return; }
3916:            }
3917:            if (aircraft.IsAirborne())
3918:            {
3919:                bool insideAf = false;
3920:                if ((aircraft.Pos().distance(ref af1) < 500.0) && (aircraft.Pos().z < 10.0)) { insideAf = true; }
3921:                if ((aircraft.Pos().distance(ref af2) < 500.0) && (aircraft.Pos().z < 70.0)) { insideAf = true; }
3922:                if ((aircraft.Pos().distance(ref af3) < 500.0) && (aircraft.Pos().z < 40.0)) { insideAf = true; }
3923:                if ((aircraft.Pos().distance(ref af4) < 500.0) && (aircraft.Pos().z < 70.0)) { insideAf = true; }
3924:                if (insideAf && stb_Debug) { Console.WriteLine("Destroying aircraft -stats.cs DPS1");
3925:				mainmission.AircraftDestroyedList[aircraft] = reason;
3926:				aircraft.Destroy(); }
3927:                else
3928:                {
3929:                    Stb_DamagePlane(aircraft, NamedDamageTypes.ControlsElevatorDisabled);
3930:                    Stb_DamagePlane(aircraft, NamedDamageTypes.ControlsAileronsDisabled);
3931:                    Stb_DamagePlane(aircraft, NamedDamageTypes.ControlsRudderDisabled);
3932:                    Stb_DamagePlane(aircraft, NamedDamageTypes.Eng0TotalSeizure);
3933:                    AiAirGroup aag = aircraft.AirGroup();
3934:                    if (aag != null)
3935:                    {
3936:                        if (aag.aircraftEnginesNum() == 2) { Stb_DamagePlane(aircraft, NamedDamageTypes.Eng1TotalSeizure); }
3937:                    }
3938:                }
3939:            }
3940:            else
3941:            {
3942:                //Console.WriteLine("Destroying aircraft -stats.cs DPS");
3943:				mainmission.AircraftDestroyedList[aircraft] = reason;
3944:                aircraft.Destroy();
3945:            }
3946:        }
3947:        catch (Exception ex) { Stb_PrepareErrorMessage(ex); }
3948:    }

4042:

4044:		## Variable Breakdown
4045:		* **`GameEventId eventId`**: The specific trigger or type of event (such as `GameEventId.BombExplosion`).
4046:		* **`Object eventArg0`**: The primary object associated with the event (often the actor, weapon, or item involved, like the specific bomb or aircraft).
4047:		* **`Object eventArg1`**: The secondary object or target associated with the event (if applicable, such as the impacted surface or damaged entity).
4048:		* **`Int32 eventArgInt`**: An integer value providing extra numerical data or parameters for the event (such as identification numbers, counts, or specific damage values).
4049:
4050:		<FollowUp>
4051:		
4052:		eventArg0: The AiActor representing the object that caused the explosion (usually the bomb itself, or the aircraft that dropped it, depending on the event stack). You can cast it using eventArg0 as AiActor.eventArg1: The Point3d structural coordinate structure (or null). This passes the specific XYZ global coordinates of the explosion map position.eventArgInt: A value that is typically 0 (or left unused). In some generic game code frameworks, it acts as an arbitrary internal event ID placeholder, but it carries no unique metrics for a standard bomb detonation.

4247:    {
4248:        Console.WriteLine("Stb_TrackPlayerFlyingTimeTimer_recurs: Starting");
4249:        Stb_trackPlayerFlyingTimeTimer = new System.Threading.Timer(
4250:            new TimerCallback(Stb_TrackPlayerFlyingTime),
4251:            null,
4252:            120000, //wait time @ startup
4253:            Stb_trackPlayerFlyingTimeTimer_interval_sec * 1000 + 3); //periodically call the callback at this interval

4256:    private void Stb_TrackPlayerFlyingTime(object o)
4257:    {
4258:        try {
4259:            //Console.WriteLine("Stb_TrackPlayerFlyingTimeTimer: Starting periodic player time check");
4260:            if (GamePlay == null) return;
4261:
4262:            List<Player> allPlayers = new List<Player>();
4263:
4264:            if (GamePlay.gpRemotePlayers() != null || GamePlay.gpRemotePlayers().Length > 0) allPlayers = GamePlay.gpRemotePlayers().ToList();
4265:
4266:            //Singleplayer or Dedi Server
4267:            if (GamePlay.gpPlayer() != null) allPlayers.Add(GamePlay.gpPlayer());
4268:
4269:            Console.WriteLine("Stb_TrackPlayerFlyingTimeTimer: Checking flight status/time for {0:n0} players currently online", allPlayers.Count);
4270:
4271:            foreach (Player player in allPlayers)
4272:            {
4273:                //if in an aircraft that is moving > 10mps we count this as flying
4274:                if (player.Place() != null && player.Place() as AiAircraft != null
4275:                    && StatCalcs.CalculatePointDistance((player.Place() as AiAircraft).AirGroup().Vwld()) > 10)
4276:                {
4277:                    StatsMission.StbStatTask sst = new StatsMission.StbStatTask(StatsMission.StbStatCommands.Mission, player.Name(), new int[] { 792, Stb_trackPlayerFlyingTimeTimer_interval_sec }, player.Place() as AiActor);
4278:                    stb_StatRecorder.StbSr_EnqueueTask(sst);
4279:                    //Console.WriteLine("Stb_TrackPlayerFlyingTimeTimer: Recording 1 min flying time for " + player.Name());
4280:                } else
4281:                {
4282:                    //Console.WriteLine("Stb_TrackPlayerFlyingTimeTimer: Recording NO flying time for " + player.Name());
4283:                }
4284:            }
4285:        }
4286:        catch (Exception ex)
4287:        {
4288:            Console.WriteLine("Stb_TrackPlayerFlyingTimeTimer ERROR: " + ex.ToString());
4289:        }

4586:    public bool isTobrukAttackBombers(AiAirGroup airGroup)
4587:    {
4588:        bool isTobrukAttackBomber = false;
4589:        if ((airGroup as AiActor != null) &&
4590:         (
4591:            ((AiActor)airGroup).Name().Contains("BoB_RAF_B_7Sqn") || ((AiActor)airGroup).Name().Contains("Tobruk_LW_JG3_II"))) //these are the 2 airgroup names we're using in the BuildBomb routine
4592:        {
4593:            //Console.WriteLine("This is a Tobruk bomber, exiting StatsMission airgroup re-target (group name matches)");
4594:            return true; //It's an airport & a high-value primary target so just bail.
4595:        }
4596:
4597:        AiWayPoint[] CurrentWaypoints = airGroup.GetWay();
4598:
4599:        foreach (AiWayPoint wp in CurrentWaypoints)
4600:        {
4601:            Point3d pos = (wp as AiAirWayPoint).P;
4602:            //TOBRUK: IF this is targeting an objective airport (would be the bumrush target in Tobruk)
4603:            //We just skip changing these waypoints altogether.
4604:            if ((wp as AiAirWayPoint).Action == AiAirWayPointType.GATTACK_POINT)
4605:            {
4606:                foreach (string key in mainmission.MissionObjectivesList.Keys)
4607:                {
4608:                    Mission.MissionObjective mo = mainmission.MissionObjectivesList[key];
4609:                    if (mainmission.MissionObjectivesList[key].Points < 10) continue;
4610:                    if (Calcs.CalculatePointDistance(pos, mo.Pos) > 3500) continue;
4611:                    if (mo.MOObjectiveType != Mission.MO_ObjectiveType.Military_Airfield) continue;
4612:                    Console.WriteLine("This is a Tobruk bomber, exiting StatsMission airgroup re-target (attacking Tobruk Primary Objective/airport)");
4613:                    return true; //It's an airport & a high-value primary target so just bail.
4614:                }
4615:            }
4616:
4617:            if ((wp as AiAirWayPoint).Action == AiAirWayPointType.GATTACK_TARG)
4618:            {
4619:                //So . . . due to Tobruk programming, if the aigroup is targeted at a CHIEF (which is like a moving ship, train, ground convoy etc) then we will 
4620:                //skip retargeting from this.  UNLESS there are more then X players online, then we will retarget.
4621:                if ((wp as AiAirWayPoint).Target != null)
4622:                {
4623:                    AiActor aia = (wp as AiAirWayPoint).Target;
4624:                    AiAIChief aiaChief = aia as AiAIChief;
4625:                    if (aiaChief != null)
4626:                    {
4627:                        Console.WriteLine("This is a Tobruk bomber, exiting StatsMission airgroup re-target (AiChief)");
4628:                        return true;
4629:                    }
4630:
4631:                }
4632:
4633:            }
4634:        }
4635:        return false;
4636:
4637:    }

5079:    //can find friendly or enemy; aircraftype any, bomber, or fighter; breather or AI
5080:    public Tuple<double?, double?, AiAirGroup> getDistanceToNearestXXXAircraftgroup(AiAirGroup from, bool friendly = true, aircraftTypes type = aircraftTypes.fighter, pilotTypes pilotType=pilotTypes.ai)
5081:    {
5082:        try
5083:        {
5084:            AiAirGroup airGroup = getNearestXXXAircraftgroup(from, friendly, type, pilotType);
5085:            if (airGroup == null) return new Tuple<double?, double?, AiAirGroup>(null, null, null);
5086:            double dist = StatCalcs.CalculatePointDistance(from.Pos(), airGroup.Pos());
5087:            double alt_diff = from.Pos().z - airGroup.Pos().z;
5088:            return new Tuple<double?, double?, AiAirGroup>(dist, alt_diff, airGroup);
5089:        }
5090:        catch (Exception ex) { Console.WriteLine("-stats FriendlyfighterDist ERROR: " + ex.ToString()); return new Tuple<double?, double?, AiAirGroup>(null, null, null); }
5091:    } 
5092:
5093:    public AiAirGroup getNearestXXXAircraftgroup(AiAirGroup from, bool friendly = true, aircraftTypes type = aircraftTypes.fighter, pilotTypes pilotType = pilotTypes.ai)
5094:    {
5095:        try
5096:        {
5097:            if (GamePlay == null) return null;
5098:            if (from == null) return null;
5099:            AiAirGroup NearestAirgroup = null;
5100:            AiAirGroup[] Airgroups;
5101:            Point3d StartPos = from.Pos();
5102:
5103:            //We can find friendly groups or enemy
5104:            int fromArmy = from.Army();
5105:            if (!friendly) fromArmy = 3 - fromArmy;
5106:
5107:            Airgroups = GamePlay.gpAirGroups((from.Army() == 1) ? 1 : 2);
5108:
5109:            if (Airgroups != null)
5110:            {
5111:                foreach (AiAirGroup airGroup in Airgroups)
5112:                {
5113:                    if (airGroup == null || airGroup.GetItems().Length == 0) continue;
5114:                    AiAircraft a = airGroup.GetItems()[0] as AiAircraft;
5115:                    string acType = StatCalcs.GetAircraftType(a);
5116:
5117:                    //Search for breather or AI aircraft, as requested
5118:                    if (pilotType != pilotTypes.any)
5119:                    {
5120:                        if (pilotType == pilotTypes.ai && !Stb_isAiControlledPlane(a)) continue;
5121:                        if (pilotType == pilotTypes.breather && Stb_isAiControlledPlane(a)) continue;
5122:                    }
5123:
5124:                    //This includes JU-87s, so it's slightly different from the configuration we've used before.  But we often have Ju-87s flying with 
5125:                    //escorts, which is the context here
5126:                    if (type != aircraftTypes.any)
5127:                    {
5128:                        bool isHeavyBomber = false;
5129:                        if (acType.Contains("Ju-88A") || acType.Contains("He-111") || acType.Contains("BR-20") || acType.Contains("BlenheimMkIV") || acType == ("Ju-87")) isHeavyBomber = true;
5130:                        if (acType.Contains("BlenheimMkIVF") || acType.Contains("BlenheimMkIVNF")) isHeavyBomber = false;
5131:                        if (type == aircraftTypes.fighter && isHeavyBomber) continue;
5132:                        if (type == aircraftTypes.bomber && !isHeavyBomber) continue;
5133:                    }
5134:                    if (NearestAirgroup != null)
5135:                    {
5136:                        if (NearestAirgroup.Pos().distance(ref StartPos) > airGroup.Pos().distance(ref StartPos))
5137:                            NearestAirgroup = airGroup;
5138:                    }
5139:                    else NearestAirgroup = airGroup;
5140:                }
5141:                return NearestAirgroup;
5142:            }
5143:            else
5144:                return null;
5145:        }
5146:        catch (Exception ex) { Console.WriteLine("-stats Friendly Fighter ERROR: " + ex.ToString()); return null; }
5147:
5148:    }

5150:    public AiAirGroup getRandomNearbyEnemyAirGroup(AiAirGroup from, double distance_m, double lowAlt_m, double highAlt_m)
5151:    {
5152:        try
5153:        {
5154:            Point3d startPos = from.Pos();
5155:            List<AiAirGroup> airGroups = getNearbyEnemyAirGroups(from, distance_m, lowAlt_m, highAlt_m);
5156:            if (airGroups == null || airGroups.Count == 0) return null;
5157:            int choice = stb_random.Next(airGroups.Count);
5158:            if (airGroups[choice].Pos().distance(ref startPos) <= distance_m / 2) //We'll somewhat favor airgroups closer to the from airgroup
5159:                choice = stb_random.Next(airGroups.Count);
5160:            return airGroups[choice];
5161:        }
5162:        catch (Exception ex) { Console.WriteLine("-stats getRandomNearbyEnemyAirGroup ERROR: " + ex.ToString()); return null; }
5163:
5164:    }

5208:    public List<AiAirGroup> getNearbyEnemyAirGroups(AiAirGroup from, double distance_m, double lowAlt_m, double highAlt_m, double minAGL_m = 0)
5209:    {
5210:        if (from == null) return null;
5211:        return getNearbyEnemyAirGroups(from.Pos(), from.Army(), distance_m, lowAlt_m, highAlt_m, minAGL_m);

5214:    //Gets all nearby enemy airgroup within distance_m (meters) and between alt - lowAlt_m & alt-highAlt_m altitude of the target
5215:    //if distance_m == 0 just gets all of them
5216:    public List<AiAirGroup> getNearbyEnemyAirGroups(Point3d StartPos, int friendlyArmy, double distance_m=0, double lowAlt_m=0, double highAlt_m=0, double minAGL_m=0)
5217:    {
5218:        try
5219:        {
5220:            if (GamePlay == null) return null;
5221:            //if ( == null) return null;
5222:            List<AiAirGroup> returnAirGroups = new List<AiAirGroup>() { };
5223:            AiAirGroup[] Airgroups;
5224:           
5225:            Airgroups = GamePlay.gpAirGroups((friendlyArmy == 1) ? 2 : 1);
5226:
5227:            if (Airgroups != null)
5228:            {
5229:                foreach (AiAirGroup airGroup in Airgroups)
5230:                {
5231:                    if (airGroup == null || airGroup.GetItems().Length == 0) continue;
5232:                    //AiAircraft a = airGroup.GetItems()[0] as AiAircraft;
5233:
5234:                    //return ALL enemy ag if distance_m == 0
5235:                    if (distance_m <= 0 ) { returnAirGroups.Add(airGroup); continue; }
5236:
5237:                    //if minAGL_m is specified (ie, > 0) then we exclude groups below that minAGL
5238:
5239:                    if (airGroup.Pos().z > StartPos.z - lowAlt_m && airGroup.Pos().z < StartPos.z + highAlt_m && airGroup.Pos().distance(ref StartPos) <= distance_m && (minAGL_m<=0 || Calcs.AltitudeAGL_m(airGroup.Pos())> minAGL_m))
5240:                        returnAirGroups.Add(airGroup);
5241:
5242:                }
5243:                return returnAirGroups;
5244:            }
5245:            else
5246:                return new List<AiAirGroup>() { };
5247:        }
5248:        catch (Exception ex) { Console.WriteLine("-stats getNearbyEnemyAirGroups ERROR: " + ex.ToString()); return new List<AiAirGroup>() { }; }
5249:
5250:    }

5601:        //Stb_Message(null, "Stats msg recvd.", null);

6222:    /***************************************************************
6223:     * PENALTIES FOR BOMBS DROPPED ON CIVILIAN AREAS
6224:     *
6225:     * Handle bombs dropping on civilian areas
6226:     * We use two special static vehicles to mark civilian areas, then here we figure out if bombs have dropped close to them.
6227:     *   * Regent II Bus (static vehicle) defines a circle of 500 meters radius that is "civilian territory".  Note that the 500m radius is implicit in the GamePlay.gpGroundStationarys(pos.x, pos.y, 500) above
6228:     *   * Maddox Games TA Sports Car (static vehicle)  defines a circle of 250 meters radius that is "civilian territory"
6229:     * Then we assess various penalties (negative kill points, finally kicking out of a/c) if bombs are dropped on civilian areas
6230:     * 
6231:     * TODO: Rather than actually subtracting points from various kill totals, it might be smarter to keep a separate tally of various
6232:     * types of penalty points, them just subtract them out when calculating things like ace, rank, whatever.  Thus we would know how many actual kills plus how many penalties received
6233:     * rather than just having them lumped together in an undifferentiated way.
6234:     ****************************************************************/
6235:
6236:    Dictionary<string, Tuple<int, DateTime>> ot_CivilianBombings = new Dictionary<string, Tuple<int, DateTime>>();
6237:
6238:    public int ot_GetCivilianBombings(string name)
6239:    {
6240:        Tuple<int, DateTime> temp;
6241:        int infract = 0; //This is the default & will be recorded if this player is not found in the dictionary at all
6242:        if (ot_CivilianBombings.TryGetValue(name, out temp))
6243:        {
6244:            infract = temp.Item1;  //Still within the delay time, so we leave the infraction count unchanged
6245:                                   //We also leave the time since last infraction unchanged (rather than changing it to 'now')
6246:        }
6247:
6248:        return infract;
6249:
6250:    }
6251:
6252:    //Records a civilian bombing infraction for a player, but only if this is a new infraction happening
6253:    //after a delay time specified below, and returns the number of infractions
6254:    //recorded for that player so far
6255:    //The idea is that one 'salvo' of bombs dropped rather close together in time only counts as one
6256:    //'infraction' for that player.
6257:    public int ot_IncCivilianBombings(string name)
6258:    {
6259:
6260:        Tuple<int, DateTime> temp;
6261:        int infract = 1; //This is the default & will be recorded if this player is not found in the dictionary at all
6262:        DateTime now = DateTime.Now;
6263:        DateTime newtime = now;
6264:
6265:        if (ot_CivilianBombings.TryGetValue(name, out temp))
6266:        {
6267:
6268:            double delay_sec = 5; //time to wait before a new infraction can be recorded
6269:            newtime = temp.Item2;  //We retain the time of last infraction unless we determine below that this is a new infraction
6270:
6271:
6272:            if (DateTime.Compare(now, temp.Item2.AddSeconds(delay_sec)) > 0)  //Is current time later than the most recent recorded infraction plus delay_sec
6273:            {
6274:
6275:                infract = temp.Item1 + 1; //Longer than the delay time, so we increment the infraction count
6276:                newtime = now; //New infraction, so we start counting time from this moment again
6277:            }
6278:            else
6279:            {
6280:                infract = temp.Item1;  //Still within the delay time, so we leave the infraction count unchanged
6281:                                       //We also leave the time since last infraction unchanged (rather than changing it to 'now')
6282:            }
6283:
6284:        }
6285:
6286:        //GamePlay.gpLogServer(null, "Infractions for " + name + ": " + infract.ToString() + " " + newtime.ToString("O"), new object[] { }); //just for testing
6287:
6288:        ot_CivilianBombings[name] = new Tuple<int, DateTime>(infract, newtime);
6289:        return infract;
6290:
6291:    }
6292:

6477:    /***************************************************************
6478:     * Handle Area Bombings
6479:     *
6480:     * "Live" areas for bombing, such as industrial or military areas.
6481:     * 
6482:     * We set up jerrycans to designate the bombable areas.  These are detected
6483:     * below in OnBombExplosion, then sent here to be handled.
6484:     * 
6485:     *    //The JerryCan_GER1_1 (static - environment - jerrycan) covers a radius of 71 meters which is just enough to fill a 100 meter square (seen in FMB at full zoom) to all corners if placed in the center of the 100m square.
6486:     *    // JerryCan_GER1_2 covers 141m radius (covers 4 100m squares to the corners if placed in the center)
6487:     *    // JerryCan_GER1_3 covers 282m radius (covers 16 100m squares to the corners if placed in the center)
6488:     *    // JerryCan_GER1_5 covers 1410m radius (a 1km square to the corner if placed in the center)
6489:     *    
6490:     *    // In MISSION BUILDER these show up as Environment Jerrycan, Environment Jerrycan x2, Environment Jerrycan x3, and Environment Jerrycan x5.
6491:     *    
6492:     *    //Do NOT use JerryCan_UK1_4-Gallon_X or any other jerry can - they will NOT register hits.
6493:     *    //In MISSION BUILDER these jerry cans that DO NOT REGISTER show up as Jerrycan 2-gallonxX or Jerrycan 4-gallonxX.
6494:     *    
6495:     *    Bombers receive points for bombing these areas (calculated below, depends on size of bomb etc)
6496:     *    Also each bomb is marked with a smoke plume.
6497:     *    
6498:     *    As of TF 4.2, 4.5, and 4.57 you can place jerrycans (stationaries) in any .mis or submission .mis file.  This will register them all.
6499:     *    This is in distinction to the built in CloD "triggers" which only pick up objects within the same .mis file, and then the trigger is only received by the corresponding .cs file (not necessarily -main.cs)
6500:     * 
6501:     ****************************************************************/
6502:
6503:
6504:    public void ot_HandleAreaBombings(string title, double mass_kg, Point3d pos, AiDamageInitiator initiator, Player player, int isEnemy = 1, string targetType = "Ground Area", double multiplier = 1, double aircraftCorrection = 1, bool crater = false, maddox.game.LandTypes landType = maddox.game.LandTypes.NONE) //IsEnemy 0=friendly, 1 enemy, 2 neutral, crater = true places a crater instead of the smoke, useful for roads, railroads, etc
6505:    {
6506:        try
6507:        {
6508:            if (player == null) return;  //This routine only scores points so there is no point in doing it unless we have a live player bombing
6509:            string playername = "AI";
6510:            if (player != null) playername = player.Name();
6511:            //GamePlay.gpLogServer(new Player[] { player }, "Area bombing by " + playername + " " + mass_kg.ToString("n0") + "kg at " + pos.x.ToString("n0") + " " + pos.y.ToString("n0"), new object[] { });
6512:
6513:            //So, the Sadovsky formula is a way of estimating the effect of a blast wave from an explosion. https://www.metabunk.org/attachments/blast-effect-calculation-1-pdf.2578/
6514:            //Simplifying slightly, it turns out that the radius of at least partial destruction/partial collapse of buildings is:
6515:            // 50 lb - 30m; 100 lb - 40 m; 250 lb - 54 m; 500 lb - 67 m; 100 lb - 85 m; etc.
6516:            //Turning this radius to an 'area of destruction' (pi * r^2) gives us an "area of destruction factor" for that size bomb.  
6517:            //Since we are scoring the amount of destruction in e.g. an industrialized area, counting the destruction points as area (square footage, square meters, whatever) is reasonable.
6518:            //Scaling our points in proportion to this "area of destruction factor" so that a 50 lb pound bomb gives 0.5 points, then we see that destruction increases with size, but lower than linearly.
6519:            //So if a 50 lb bomb gives 0.5 points, a 100 lb bomb gives 0.72 points; 250 lb 1.41 points; 500 lb 2.33 points, 1000 lb 4.0 points, 2000 lb 6.48 points, etc
6520:            //The formula below is somewhat simplified from this but approximates it pretty closely and gives a reasonable value for any mass_kg
6521:
6522:            //double scoreBase = 0.06303;
6523:            double scoreBase = 0.031515; //halving the score we were giving at first, since the point totals seem to be coming up quite high in comparison with fighter kills
6524:                                         //if (blenheim) scoreBase *= 4; //8X score for Blenheims since their bomb load is pathetic  (Blenheim = 4X 250 lb bombs, HE111 = 32X 100kg bombs  -> 4*8 = 32
6525:            //scoreBase *= aircraftCorrection; //correcting for lower tonnage carried by Blenheim, HE111, etc.  AircraftCorrection should be applied to the _kg NOT here. 2023-01
6526:            scoreBase *= multiplier;  //We can adjust score for various type of terrain or target areas etc by sending a different multipler
6527:
6528:
6529:
6530:            if (mass_kg <= 0) mass_kg = 22;  //50 lb bomb; 22kg
6531:            double score = scoreBase * Math.Pow(mass_kg* aircraftCorrection, 0.67);
6532:
6533:            /* Another way to reach the same end- probably quicker but less flexible & doesn't interpolate:
6534:             * 
6535:             * //Default is 0.5 points for ie 50 lb bomb
6536:             * if (mass_kg > 45) score = 0.722; //100 lb  (calcs assume radius of partial/serious building destruction per Sadovsky formula, dP > 0.10, explosion on surface of ground, and that 50% of bomb weight is TNT)
6537:            if (mass_kg > 110) score = 1.41; //250 
6538:            if (mass_kg > 220) score = 2.33; //500
6539:            if (mass_kg > 440) score = 3.70; //1000
6540:            if (mass_kg > 880) score = 5.92; //2000
6541:            if (mass_kg > 1760) score = 9.33 ; //4000
6542:
6543:             */
6544:
6545:            //0 friendly, 1 = enemy, 2 = neutral
6546:            //if (isEnemy == 0 || isEnemy == 2)
6547:            //TOBRUK, bombing neutral territory is OK, not a prob.
6548:            //2021/06: BOTH - can bomb enemy  or neutral terr
6549:            //IF there are enemy groundactors nearby
6550:            //This allows to send enemy convoys into neutral
6551:            //OR friendly territory & they can be bombed etc
6552:            if (isEnemy == 0 || isEnemy == 2)
6553:
6554:            {
6555:                if (initiator.Player != null) {
6556:                    bool nearbyTargs = Calcs.anyEnemyOrNeutralStationaries(GamePlay, pos.x, pos.y, 2000, initiator.Player.Army());
6557:
6558:                    int matcharmy = initiator.Player.Army();
6559:
6560:                    int numberNearbyEnemyGroundActors = Calcs.CountGroundActors(GamePlay, mainmission, mainmission.AllGroundDict, pos, 2500, matcharmy: 3 - matcharmy, type: "");
6561:
6562:
6563:                    if (!nearbyTargs && numberNearbyEnemyGroundActors == 0)
6564:            {
6565:
6566:                score = -score;  //Bombing on friendly/neutral territory earns you a NEGATIVE score
6567:                                 //but, still helps destroy the objects/area (for your enemies) as usual
6568:                                         //GamePlay.gpLogServer(null, player.Name() + " has bombed a friendly or neutral zone or target. Serious repercussions for player AND team.", new object[] { });
6569:                        GamePlay.gpLogServer(null, player.Name() + " has bombed a friendly zone or target. Serious repercussions for player AND team.", new object[] { });
6570:                    }
6571:                }
6572:
6573:            }
6574:			
6575:
6576:            //TODO: Should collect these over a 5-10 sec time frame & print summary, bec. many bombs often hit very close to same time
6577:            ////TESTING: turning off ground target  hit messages to see if that helps our warping problem 9/28/2018
6578:
6579:            Timeout(0.4 + stb_random.NextDouble() * 25, () =>
6580:            {
6581:                if (player != null && score >= 0.1) GamePlay.gpLogServer(new Player[] { player }, targetType + " hit: " + mass_kg.ToString("n0") + "kg " + score.ToString("n1") + " points ", new object[] { });
6582:            }); //+ pos.x.ToString("n0") + " " + pos.y.ToString("n0")
6583:
6584:
6585:            stb_RecordStatsOnActorDead(initiator, 4, score, 1, initiator.Tool.Type);  //So they have dropped a bomb on an active industrial area or area bombing target they get a point.
6586:                                                                                      //TODO: More/less points depending on bomb tonnage.
6587:            if (initiator.Actor != null)
6588:            {
6589:                Player player1 = null;
6590:                if (mainmission != null && mainmission.covermission != null) player1 = mainmission.covermission.getOwnerOfCoverAircraft(initiator.Actor);
6591:                if (player1 != null) stb_RecordNearbyPlayerStatsOnActorDead(player1, raw_score: score, killtype: 4);
6592:            }
6593:			
6594:			//2026-08: Now we're letting mainmission handle ALL smoke, fire, craters from bombs
6595:			
6596:			/*
6597:            //TF_Extensions.TF_GamePlay.Effect smoke = TF_Extensions.TF_GamePlay.Effect.SmokeSmall;
6598:            // TF_Extensions.TF_GamePlay.gpCreateEffect(GamePlay, smoke, pos.x, pos.y, pos.z, 1200);
6599:            string firetype = "BuildingFireSmall";
6600:            //if (mass_kg > 200) firetype = "BigSitySmoke_1"; //500lb bomb or larger
6601:            if (mass_kg > 200) firetype = "Smoke1"; //500lb bomb or larger
6602:
6603:            //TOBRUK (and 2021/06 CLOD) adding in possibility of bombs landing on water. No crater, sometimes a bit of smoke
6604:            if (Calcs.isPointInOrNearWater(GamePlay, pos, radius_m: 10))
6605:            {
6606:                crater = false;
6607:                firetype = "";
6608:                if (stb_random.Next(100)<3) firetype = "BuildingFireSmall"; //once in a while there is smoke for a water explosion.
6609:
6610:            }
6611:
6612:            if (crater)
6613:            {
6614:                firetype = "BombCrater_firmSoil_mediumkg";
6615:                if (mass_kg > 100) firetype = "BombCrater_firmSoil_largekg"; //250lb bomb or larger
6616:                if (mass_kg > 200) firetype = "BombCrater_firmSoil_EXlargekg"; //500lb bomb or larger.  EXLarge is actually 3 large craters slightly offset to make 1 bigger crater
6617:            }
6618:
6619:            //Z for stationaries is HEIGHT ABOVE GROUND not xyz position
6620:            loadSmokeOrFire(pos.x, pos.y, 0, firetype, 20, stb_FullPath);
6621:            //todo: finer grained bigger/smaller fire depending on bomb tonnage
6622:
6623:            //BigSitySmoke_0 BigSitySmoke_1 BuildingFireBig BuildingFireSmall Smoke1 Smoke2
6624:			*/
6625:
6626:        }
6627:        catch (Exception ex) { Console.WriteLine("ot_Handleareabombings: " + ex.ToString()); }

6650:    /************************************************************
6651:    * 
6652:    * handle airport bombing
6653:    * most credit/script idea for airport bombing & destruction goes to reddog/Storm of War
6654:    * 
6655:    * We give credit (points) for any bomb that hits within the radius of an airfield.
6656:    * Also, these bomb hits are marked with a plume of smoke and additionally a bomb crater is added that is dangerous/will kill aircraft taxiing on the ground
6657:    * 
6658:    * Craters are different sizes, depending on tonnage of bomb dropped.  Also, craters will be repaired, taking a shorter time for smaller craters & a longer time for bigger craters
6659:    * Additionally, the more craters dropped on an airport the longer it will take to get to the next crater  & repair it.
6660:    * Also, if a threshold of tonnage (counted as points, which are proportional to damage done) is reached, the airport is put out of commission by severely cratering it
6661:    * 
6662:    * //Version for -stats.cs//
6663:    *************************************************************/
6664:
6665:    public Dictionary<AiAirport, Tuple<bool, string, double, double, DateTime, double, Point3d>> AirfieldTargets = new Dictionary<AiAirport, Tuple<bool, string, double, double, DateTime, double, Point3d>>();
6666:    //Tuple is: bool airfield disabled, string name, double pointstoknockout, double damage point total, DateTime time of last damage hit, double airfield radius, Point3d airfield center (position)
6667:    //TODO: it would nice to have a struct or something to hold this instead of a tuple . . . 
6668:
6669:    public void SetAirfieldTargets()
6670:    {
6671:        foreach (AiAirport ap in GamePlay.gpAirports()) //Loop through all airfields in the game
6672:        {
6673:
6674:            //We're just going to add ALL airfields as targets, but then make sure there are no duplicates (bec. built-in & .mis-added airports sometimes overlap).
6675:
6676:            //It's going to take blue pilots more points/bombs to knock out an airfield, vs Red (Blenheims very limited as far as the # of bombs they can carry)
6677:
6678:            ////Use this for TACTICAL SERVER (where Reds only have Blenheims)
6679:            //UPDATE 2017/11/06: We don't need this adjustment bec. we have adjusted the points received
6680:            //so that blenheims receive relatively more & the blue bombers relatively less.  So this 
6681:            //should handle the discrepancy between the sides with no further adjustment necessary
6682:            //int pointstoknockout = 30;
6683:            //if (ap.Army() != null && ap.Army() == 1) pointstoknockout = 65;
6684:
6685:            ////Use this for MISSION SERVER  && TACTICAL SERVER 
6686:            int pointstoknockout = 200;  //30 pts is about two HE111 or JU88 loads (or 1 full load & just a little more) and about 4 Blennie loads, but it depends on how accurate the bombs are, and how large //2020-02 - AHA, this was 30 in the -main.cs and 65 here.  So this seemed to easy on both ends, trying 90 instead.  90 is about 4 JU88 or BLenheim loads well placed. whatever is here needs to be in -main.cs corresponding place also.
6687:
6688:            double radius = ap.FieldR();
6689:            Point3d center = ap.Pos();
6690:
6691:
6692:            //GamePlay.gpAirports() includes both built-in airports and any new airports we have added in our .mis files. This results in duplication since
6693:            //most .mis airports are placed on top of an existing built-in airport. We check whether this airport has already been added & skip adding it if so.
6694:            Point3d pos = ap.Pos();
6695:            bool add = true;
6696:            foreach (AiAirport apk in AirfieldTargets.Keys)//Loop through the targets
6697:            {
6698:                if (apk != null & apk.Pos().distance(ref pos) <= apk.FieldR())
6699:                {
6700:                    //AirfieldTargets[apk].Item3
6701:                    add = false; //
6702:                    if (apk.FieldR() != null && apk.FieldR() > 1) radius = apk.FieldR(); //The field radius set in the .mis file becomes operative if it exists & is reasonable
6703:                    center = apk.Pos();  //We use the position of the airport set i nthe .mis file for the center, if it exists - thus we can change/move the center position as we wish
6704:                    break;
6705:                }
6706:            }
6707:
6708:            //We'll get the NAME of the airport from the birthplace/spawn point declare in a .mis file, if it exists
6709:
6710:            string apName = ap.Name();
6711:            foreach (AiBirthPlace bp in GamePlay.gpBirthPlaces())
6712:            {
6713:                if (bp != null & bp.Pos().distance(ref pos) <= ap.FieldR())
6714:                {
6715:                    if (bp.Name() != null && !(bp.Name().ToUpper().Contains("BIRTHPLACE"))) apName = bp.Name();  //We will use the spawn point/birthplace name UNLESS it is just "BirthPlace0" or whatever
6716:                    break;
6717:                }
6718:            }
6719:
6720:
6721:            if (add) AirfieldTargets.Add(ap, new Tuple<bool, string, double, double, DateTime, double, Point3d>(false, apName, pointstoknockout, 0, DateTime.Now, radius, center)); //Adds airfield to dictionary, requires approx 2 loads of 32 X 50lb bombs of bombs to knock out.
6722:                                                                                                                                                                                    //Tuple is: bool airfield disabled, string name, double pointstoknockout, double damage point total, DateTime time of last damage hit, double airfield radius
6723:                                                                                                                                                                                    //if you want to add only some airfields as targets, use something like: if (ap.Name().Contains("Manston")) { }
6724:
6725:        }
6726:        GamePlay.gpLogServer(null, "SetAirfieldTargets initialized. (-stats)", null);
6727:    }
