6729:    public void ListAirfieldTargetDamage(Player player = null, int army = -1, bool all = false)
6730:    {
6731:        int count = 0;
6732:        foreach (AiAirport ap in AirfieldTargets.Keys)
6733:        {
6734:
6735:            double PointsTaken = AirfieldTargets[ap].Item4;
6736:            bool disabled = AirfieldTargets[ap].Item1;
6737:
6738:            if (!all && PointsTaken == 0 && !disabled) continue; //we'll list only airports damaged or disabled, skipping those with no damage at all, unless called with all=true
6739:            if (army != -1 & army != ap.Army()) continue; //List only the army requested, skipping the others.  army = -1 means list both/all armies
6740:
6741:            count++;
6742:            double PointsToKnockOut = AirfieldTargets[ap].Item3;
6743:            string Mission = AirfieldTargets[ap].Item2;
6744:            DateTime lastBombHit = AirfieldTargets[ap].Item5;
6745:
6746:            double percent = 0;
6747:            if (PointsToKnockOut > 0)
6748:            {
6749:                percent = PointsTaken / PointsToKnockOut;
6750:            }
6751:
6752:            double timereduction = 0;
6753:            if (percent > 0)
6754:            {
6755:                timereduction = (DateTime.Now.Subtract(lastBombHit)).TotalSeconds;
6756:            }
6757:
6758:            double timetofix = PointsTaken * 20 * 60 - timereduction; //50 lb bomb scores 0.5 so will take 10 minutes to repair.  Larger bombs will take longer; 250 lb about 1.4 points so 28 minutes to repeari
6759:                                                                      //But . . . it is ADDITIVE. So the first 50 lb bomb takes 10 minutes, the 2nd another 10, the 3rd another 10, and so on on.  So if you drop 32 50 bl bombs it will take 320 minutes before the 32nd bomb crater is repaired.
6760:                                                                      //Sources: "A crater from a 500lb bomb could be repaired and resurfaced in about 40 minutes" says one 2nd hand source. That seems about right, depending on methods & surface. https://www.airspacemag.com/multimedia/these-portable-runways-helped-win-war-pacific-180951234/
6761:                                                                      //unfortunately we can repair only the bomb crater; the SMOKE will remain for the entire mission because clod internals don't allow its removal.
6762:                                                                      //TODO: We could keep track of when the last bomb was dropped at each airport and deduct time here depending on how much repair had been done since the last bomb dropped
6763:
6764:            if (PointsTaken >= PointsToKnockOut) //airport knocked out
6765:            {
6766:                percent = 1;
6767:                timetofix = 24 * 60 * 60; //24 hours to repair . . . 
6768:            }
6769:
6770:            GamePlay.gpLogServer(new Player[] { player }, Mission + " " + (percent * 100).ToString("n0") + "% destroyed; last hit " + (timereduction / 60).ToString("n0") + " minutes ago", new object[] { });
6771:
6772:
6773:        }
6774:        if (count == 0) GamePlay.gpLogServer(new Player[] { player }, "No airports damaged or destroyed yet", new object[] { });
6775:    }

7226:                /* if (!AirfieldTargets[ap].Item1)

7233:                double radius = AirfieldTargets[ap].Item6;
7234:                Point3d APPos = AirfieldTargets[ap].Item7;
7235:                double distFromCenter = 1000000000;
7236:                if (ap != null) distFromCenter = APPos.distance(ref pos);
7237:                //Check if bomb fell inside radius and if so increment up
7238:                if (ap != null & distFromCenter <= radius)//has bomb landed inside airfield check
7239:                {
7240:
7241:
7242:                    //So, the Sadovsky formula is a way of estimating the effect of a blast wave from an explosion. https://www.metabunk.org/attachments/blast-effect-calculation-1-pdf.2578/
7243:                    //Simplifying slightly, it turns out that the radius of at least partial destruction/partial collapse of buildings is:
7244:                    // 50 lb - 30m; 100 lb - 40 m; 250 lb - 54 m; 500 lb - 67 m; 100 lb - 85 m; etc.
7245:                    //Turning this radius to an 'area of destruction' (pi * r^2) gives us an "area of destruction factor" for that size bomb.  
7246:                    //Since we are scoring the amount of destruction in e.g. an industrialized area, counting the destruction points as area (square footage, square meters, whatever) is reasonable.
7247:                    //Scaling our points in proportion to this "area of destruction factor" so that a 50 lb pound bomb gives 0.5 points, then we see that destruction increases with size, but lower than linearly.

8436:		string saveReason = "";

8508:					} else { //"DEPENDS" or don't know reason

What if the player has quit the server entirely at this point, or has left that aircraft (which is then destroyed rather quickly) and entered another a/c.

8663:    public void stb_setPilotType(Player player, AiActor actor)
8664:    {
8665:
8666:        if (player.Name() == null || player.Name() == "") return;
8667:
8668:        AiAircraft aircraft = null;
8669:        string acType = "";
8670:        string playerBomberFighter = "";
8671:        string playerTeam = "";
8672:        if (actor is AiAircraft)
8673:        {
8674:
8675:            aircraft = actor as AiAircraft;
8676:            acType = StatCalcs.GetAircraftType(aircraft);
8677:
8678:        }
8679:        else if (player.Place() != null && (player.Place() as AiAircraft) != null)
8680:        {
8681:            //Player player = actor as Player;
8682:            aircraft = player.Place() as AiAircraft;
8683:            acType = StatCalcs.GetAircraftType(aircraft);
8684:        }
8685:
8686:        if (aircraft == null)
8687:        {
8688:            Console.WriteLine("stb_setPilotType: Aircraft is null, so exiting without setting pilot type (may be a parachute, ground vehicle? " + stb_StatRecorder.StbSr_MassagePlayername(player.Name()) + " " + base.Time.current().ToString());
8689:            return;
8690:        }
8691:
8692:        //if (acType.Contains("Ju-88") || acType.Contains("He-111") || acType.Contains("BR-20") || acType == ("BlenheimMkIV") || acType == ("BlenheimMkIV_Late") )
8693:        //Even though there is technically a Blenheim fighter we're calling it "bomber" for this purpose.  It carries (some) bombs.
8694:        //if (acType.Contains("Ju-88") || acType.Contains("He-111") || acType.Contains("BR-20") || acType.Contains("Blenheim"))
8695:        //if (Calcs.isHeavyBomber(acType) || Calcs.isDiveBomber(acType))
8696:
8697:        if (Calcs.isDiveBomber(acType)) //special career for Stukas
8698:        {
8699:            playerBomberFighter = " " + stb_DiveBomberSuffix;
8700:            
8701:        } else if (Calcs.isHeavyBomber(acType))
8702:        {
8703:            playerBomberFighter = " " + stb_BomberSuffix;
8704:
8705:        } else if (Calcs.isStrikeAC(acType) && !acType.Contains("HurricaneMkIIc"))  //HurricaneMkIIc is still classified as a fighter
8706:        {
8707:            playerBomberFighter = " " + stb_StrikeSuffix;
8708:
8709:        }
8710:
8711:        //Save the info needed for career type of this player at this moment (generally, the moment of entering a position)
8712:        stb_PilotType[player.Name()] = new Tuple<string, string, double>(playerBomberFighter, playerTeam, base.Time.current());
8713:        Console.WriteLine("stb_setPilotType: " + playerBomberFighter + " " + playerTeam + " " + base.Time.current().ToString());
8714:
8715:        //Save a record of all players who have entered this aircraft, along with time entered & other info about their career
8716:        if (aircraft != null && player.Name() != null)
8717:        {
8718:            Dictionary<string, List<Tuple<string, string, double>>> currAircraftRecord = new Dictionary<string, List<Tuple<string, string, double>>>();
8719:
8720:            if (!stb_PilotTypeRecordbyAC.TryGetValue(actor.Name(), out currAircraftRecord))
8721:            {
8722:                currAircraftRecord = new Dictionary<string, List<Tuple<string, string, double>>>();
8723:            }
8724:
8725:            List<Tuple<string, string, double>> currPilotRecord = new List<Tuple<string, string, double>>();
8726:
8727:            if (!currAircraftRecord.TryGetValue(player.Name(), out currPilotRecord))
8728:            {
8729:                currPilotRecord = new List<Tuple<string, string, double>>();
8730:            }
8731:
8732:            currPilotRecord.Add(stb_PilotType[player.Name()]);
8733:            currAircraftRecord[player.Name()] = currPilotRecord;
8734:            stb_PilotTypeRecordbyAC[actor.Name()] = currAircraftRecord;
8735:        }
8736:    }

8739:    {
8740:        Tuple<string, string, double> temp = new Tuple<string, string, double>("", "", 0);
8741:

8743:        {
8744:            temp = new Tuple<string, string, double>("", "", 0);
8745:        }
8746:
8747:        return temp;
8748:    }

9110:    public void stb_RecordStatsOnActorDead(AiDamageInitiator initiator, int killtype, double score, double totalscore, AiDamageToolType toolType, AiAircraft aiAircraft = null, AiActor deadActor = null, GroundStationary deadStationary = null)
9111:    {
9112:        try {
9113:            //stb_StatRecorder.StbSr_WriteLine("Recording Damage: {0} {1} {2} {3}", score, totalscore, killtype, toolType);
9114:            //killtype 1 = aerial, 2 = aa/artillery/tank, 3=ship, 4=other ground
9115:
9116:            //return; //TESTING
9117:
9118:            Player player = null;
9119:            string playerName = "";
9120:            AiActor playerPlaceActor = null;
9121:            if (initiator != null && initiator.Player != null && initiator.Player.Name() != null) {
9122:                player = initiator.Player;
9123:                playerName = initiator.Player.Name();
9124:            }
9125:            else return; //not much to do if we don't have player
9126:
9127:            if (initiator.Player.Place() != null && initiator.Player.Place() as AiActor != null) playerPlaceActor = initiator.Player.Place() as AiActor;
9128:
9129:
9130:            //Save the percentage credit towards the kill (all kill types lumped together into one grand total)
9131:            int percent_score = (int)Math.Round(score / totalscore * 100.0);
9132:            if (Math.Abs(totalscore) < 0.01) percent_score = 0; //if totalscore==0 we set it to 0.00001 instead, but really just meaningless
9133:            if (percent_score < -3000) percent_score = -3000; //limit negative/removed points possible.  Just for sanity.
9134:            int percent_score_norm = (int)Math.Round((double)percent_score / (double)100.0);  //normed to 1=1 victory (rather than 100% = one victory)
9135:

9323:                {
9324:                    if (player == null || player.Place() == null) continue;
9325:                    if (aArmy == player.Army()) continue;
9326:

9329:

9331:                    {
9332:                        ret[player] = dist_m;

9334:                    }
9335:                }

9367:    {

9369:        if (totalscore < score || totalscore < 0.05 ) return coverPlayers2; //This is the case where score == 0.0001 or whatever.  So score/totalscore is really an invalid value and the score is self-harm or friendly fire (that is why the totalscore == 0.0001)
9370:        Player player = null;
9371:        if (mainmission != null && mainmission.covermission != null) player = mainmission.covermission.getOwnerOfCoverAircraft(actor); 
9372:        if (player == null) return coverPlayers2;
9373:        double tot = score/totalscore;  //This is just the total of all their cover aircraft score for this kill.  So later we can take some fraction of this to add to their score.
9374:        if (coverPlayers2.ContainsKey(player)) coverPlayers2[player] += tot;
9375:        else coverPlayers2[player] = tot;
9376:        //Console.WriteLine("Adding cover player credit {0} {1} {2}", tot, coverPlayers2[player], player.Name());
9377:        return coverPlayers2;

10268:                //If landing in water, you chance of rescue goes up 25% if home waters, down 25% if enemy water

10819:        public void OnPersonParachuteLanded(AiActor actor, Player player, maddox.game.world.AiPerson person = null)
10820:        {
10821:
10822:            if (player == null || player.Name() == null) return; //no point in doing anything at all here in these cases
10823:            string PlayerName = player.Name();
10824:            string PlayerNameM = stb_StatRecorder.StbSr_MassagePlayername(PlayerName, actor); //Name massaged with (bomber) etc.
10825:            if (recentlyParachutedOrCrashedOrLanded(PlayerName)) return;
10826:
10827:            //All these result in loss of a/c, even if life saved
10828:            Console.WriteLine("Forcing exit 1");
10829:            if (supplymission != null) supplymission.SupplyOnPlaceLeave(player, actor, 0, false, 1); //the final "1" forced 100% damage of aircraft/write-off
10830:
10831:            bool playerDied = false;
10832:            if (GamePlay.gpLandType(actor.Pos().x, actor.Pos().y) == LandTypes.WATER) // landed in water
10833:            {
10834:                double Luck = stb_random.NextDouble();
10835:                double Luck2 = stb_random.NextDouble();
10836:                double RescueChance = stb_ASR_RescueChanceRed;
10837:                string parachute_message = StatCalcs.randSTR(stb_PARACHUTED_FRIENDLY_MSG);
10838:                if (actor.Army() == 2) RescueChance = stb_ASR_RescueChanceBlue;
10839:
10840:                if (actor.Army() == GamePlay.gpFrontArmy(actor.Pos().x, actor.Pos().y))
10841:                    RescueChance = stb_ASR_RescueChanceFriendly * RescueChance;
10842:                else
10843:                {
10844:                    RescueChance = stb_ASR_RescueChanceEnemy * RescueChance;
10845:                    parachute_message = StatCalcs.randSTR(stb_PARACHUTED_ENEMY_MSG);
10846:                }
10847:
10848:
10849:                if (Luck < RescueChance)
10850:                {   // ASR success
10851:                    Console.WriteLine("Parachute Water: Luck " + Luck.ToString("F2") + " " + RescueChance.ToString("F2"));
10852:                    if (actor.Army() == GamePlay.gpFrontArmy(actor.Pos().x, actor.Pos().y)) // landed in friendly waters
10853:                    {
10854:                        gpLogServerAndLog(null, parachute_message + " " + StatCalcs.randSTR(stb_ASR_RESCUE_MSG), new object[] { PlayerNameM });
10855:                    }
10856:                    else
10857:                    {   // landed in enemy waters
10858:                        //Player has landed in enemy waters & picked up by enemy ASR but has a chance to escape
10859:                        double EscapeChance = stb_POW_EscapeChanceRed;
10860:                        if (actor.Army() == 2) EscapeChance = stb_POW_EscapeChanceBlue;
10861:                        if (Luck2 > (1 - EscapeChance))
10862:                        {   // player escaped capture
10863:                            gpLogServerAndLog(null, StatCalcs.randSTR(stb_PARACHUTED_ENEMY_MSG) + StatCalcs.randSTR(stb_ESCAPED_MSG), new object[] { PlayerNameM });
10864:                        }
10865:                        else
10866:                        {
10867:                            gpLogServerAndLog(null, parachute_message + " " + StatCalcs.randSTR(stb_ASR_CAPTURE_MSG), new object[] { PlayerNameM });
10868:                            playerDied = true;
10869:                        }
10870:                    }
10871:                }
10872:                else
10873:                {   // ASR failure
10874:                    Console.WriteLine("Parachute Water: Luck " + Luck.ToString("F2") + " " + RescueChance.ToString("F2"));
10875:                    gpLogServerAndLog(null, parachute_message + " " + StatCalcs.randSTR(stb_ASR_FAIL_DROWNED), new object[] { PlayerNameM });
10876:                    playerDied = true;
10877:                }
10878:            }
10879:
10880:            // landed on solid ground & enemy
10881:            else if (GamePlay.gpFrontArmy(actor.Pos().x, actor.Pos().y) != actor.Army())
10882:            {
10883:
10884:                double Luck = stb_random.NextDouble();
10885:                double EscapeChance = stb_POW_EscapeChanceRed;
10886:                if (actor.Army() == 2) EscapeChance = stb_POW_EscapeChanceBlue;
10887:
10888:                if (Luck > (1 - EscapeChance))
10889:                {   // player escaped capture
10890:                    gpLogServerAndLog(null, StatCalcs.randSTR(stb_PARACHUTED_ENEMY_MSG) + StatCalcs.randSTR(stb_ESCAPED_MSG), new object[] { PlayerNameM });
10891:                }
10892:                else
10893:                {   // player captured
10894:                    gpLogServerAndLog(null, StatCalcs.randSTR(stb_PARACHUTED_ENEMY_MSG) + StatCalcs.randSTR(stb_CAPTURED_MSG) + StatCalcs.randSTR(stb_FINAL_CAPTURED_MSG), new object[] { PlayerNameM });
10895:                    playerDied = true;
10896:                }
10897:            }
10898:            else   // landed in friendly territory
10899:            {
10900:                gpLogServerAndLog(null, StatCalcs.randSTR(stb_PARACHUTED_FRIENDLY_MSG), new object[] { PlayerNameM });
10901:            }
10902:
10903:
10904:
10905:            //if killed by any of the incidents above, here is where the player actually dies
10906:            if (playerDied)
10907:            {
10908:                double res = 0;
10909:                //2=self-kill, 1 = regular kill; we're going to say parachuting death is never a self-kill as you were
10910:                //intending to parachute and survive, but got killed SOMEHOW regardless.
10911:                res = stb_RecordStatsForKilledPlayerOnActorDead(player.Name(), 1, player as AiActor, player, false, forceDeath: true); //They are dead, so kill immediately (ie, before players are removed from a/
10912:                if (person != null) Stb_killActor(person as AiActor, 0, "DEAD_stats_Player Died");
10913:                //Give an indication we're supposed to be killing this player
10914:                gpLogServerAndLog(null, "{0} has been killed or captured - the end of a glorious career!  (" + res.ToString() + ")", new object[] { PlayerNameM });
10915:            }
10916:
10917:            //Stb_Message(null, "Parachute Landed " + person.Player().Name(), new object[] { });
10918:            //Player player = person as Player;
10919:            if (player != null && player.Name() != null)
10920:            {
10921:                int record = 775; //successful parachute
10922:                if (playerDied) record = 774; //failed parachute
10923:                StbStatTask sst1 = new StbStatTask(StbStatCommands.Mission, player.Name(), new int[] { record }, player.Place() as AiActor);
10924:                stb_StatRecorder.StbSr_EnqueueTask(sst1);

11204:        { // constructor
11205:            m_KilledActors = new List<Tuple<AiActor, AiDamageInitiator, NamedDamageTypes, List<DamagerScore>>>();
11206:        }
11207:
11208:        private static readonly KilledActorsWrapper instance = new KilledActorsWrapper(); // only one instance of class allowed
11209:
11210:        public static KilledActorsWrapper Instance
11211:        {
11212:            get { return instance; }
11213:        }
11214:
11215:        public void Add(AiActor killedActor, List<DamagerScore> damages)
11216:        {
11217:            //Console.WriteLine("ENTERED ADD METHOD A");
11218:            Tuple<AiActor, AiDamageInitiator, NamedDamageTypes, List<DamagerScore>> tuple = new Tuple<AiActor, AiDamageInitiator, NamedDamageTypes,
11219:            List<DamagerScore>>(killedActor, null, NamedDamageTypes.AirbrakeDriveFailure, damages);
11220:            //List<DamagerScore>>(killedActor, null, null, damages);
11221:
11222:            //Console.WriteLine("ENTERED ADD METHOD A-1");
11223:            m_KilledActors.Add(tuple);
11224:            //Console.WriteLine("ENTERED ADD METHOD A-2");
11225:        }
11226:
11227:        public void Add(AiActor killedActor, AiDamageInitiator initiator, NamedDamageTypes damageType)
11228:        {
11229:            //Console.WriteLine("ENTERED ADD METHOD B");
11230:            Tuple<AiActor, AiDamageInitiator, NamedDamageTypes, List<DamagerScore>> tuple = new Tuple<AiActor, AiDamageInitiator, NamedDamageTypes,
11231:            List<DamagerScore>>(killedActor, initiator, damageType, null);
11232:            //Console.WriteLine("ENTERED ADD METHOD B-1");
11233:            this.m_KilledActors.Add(tuple);
11234:            //Console.WriteLine("ENTERED ADD METHOD B-2");
11235:        }
11236:
11237:        public int Count
11238:        {
11239:            get { return m_KilledActors.Count; }
11240:        }
11241:
11242:        public List<DamagerScore> GetDamagerScore(AiActor killedActor)
11243:        {
11244:            List<DamagerScore> damagerscore = new List<DamagerScore>() { };
11245:            for (int i = 0; i < m_KilledActors.Count; i++)
11246:            {
11247:                if (m_KilledActors[i].Item1 == killedActor)
11248:                {
11249:                    damagerscore.Add((DamagerScore)m_KilledActors[i].Item1);
11250:                }
11251:            }
11252:            return damagerscore;
11253:        }
11254:
11255:        public List<AiDamageInitiator> GetDamageInitiators(AiActor killedActor)
11256:        {
11257:            List<AiDamageInitiator> damageinitiators = new List<AiDamageInitiator>();
11258:            for (int i = 0; i < m_KilledActors.Count; i++)
11259:            {
11260:                if (m_KilledActors[i].Item1 == killedActor)
11261:                {
11262:                    damageinitiators.Add((AiDamageInitiator)m_KilledActors[i].Item2);
11263:                }
11264:            }
11265:            return damageinitiators;
11266:        }
11267:
11268:        public List<NamedDamageTypes> GetNamedDamageTypes(AiActor actor)
11269:        {
11270:            List<NamedDamageTypes> nameddamagetypes = new List<NamedDamageTypes>();
11271:            for (int i = 0; i < m_KilledActors.Count; i++)
11272:            {
11273:                if (m_KilledActors[i].Item1 == actor)
11274:                {
11275:                    nameddamagetypes.Add((NamedDamageTypes)m_KilledActors[i].Item3);
11276:                }
11277:            }
11278:            return nameddamagetypes;
11279:        }
11280:
11281:        public void Clear()
11282:        {
11283:            m_KilledActors.Clear();
11284:        }
11285:        private List<Tuple<AiActor, AiDamageInitiator, NamedDamageTypes, List<DamagerScore>>> m_KilledActors { get; set; }
11286:    }

11564:        public bool StbRaa_isPlayerAllowedAircraft(AiAircraft aircraft, Player player, AiActor actor)
11565:        {
11566:
11567:            string playerName = this.mission.stb_StatRecorder.StbSr_MassagePlayername(player.Name());
11568:            int rank = this.mission.stb_StatRecorder.StbSr_RankAsIntFromName(playerName);

11570:            string aircraft_type = StatCalcs.GetAircraftType(aircraft);
11571:
11572:            //It turns out you can't use NULL in a dictionary key lookup, so here is how we handle it.
11573:            //Not sure WHY we are getting null here at all, but whatever.
11574:            //Update - I think it is if the player is put into a parachute, and also perhaps (?) things like ground vehicles
11575:            if (!(actor is AiAircraft)) return true; //we don't restrict anything but AIRCRAFT here. Tanks, parachute, whatever else is OK.
11576:            if (aircraft == null || aircraft_type == null)
11577:            {
11578:                if (this.mission.stb_restrictAircraftByKills || this.mission.stb_restrictAircraftByRank)
11579:                {

11581:                    //if (player != null) mission.Stb_Message(new Player[] { player }, "Restricted from this aircraft because of your rank or ace level OR a general error has occured. Please report to the admins if you feel this is in error.", new object[] { });
11582:                    return false;
11583:                }
11584:                else return true;
11585:            }
11586:
11587:            //Console.WriteLine("Rank: {0} Kills: {1} Type: {2}", rank, numberofkills, aircraft_type);
11588:
11589:            Dictionary<string, int> allowedAircraftByAce = stbRaa_AllowedAircraftByAce_Red;
11590:            if (player.Army() == 2) allowedAircraftByAce = stbRaa_AllowedAircraftByAce_Blue;
11591:
11592:            Dictionary<string, int> allowedAircraftByRank = stbRaa_AllowedAircraftByRank_Red;
11593:            if (player.Army() == 2) allowedAircraftByRank = stbRaa_AllowedAircraftByRank_Blue;
11594:
11595:            int required_kills;
11596:
11597:            if (!allowedAircraftByAce.TryGetValue(aircraft_type, out required_kills)) required_kills = -1;  // -1 means this a/c wasn't listed in the table.  If not listed, it will be ALLOWED
11598:                                                                                                            //Console.WriteLine("reqkills: {0}", required_kills);
11599:                                                                                                            //if ( (!this.mission.stb_restrictAircraftByKills  && !this.mission.stb_restrictAircraftByRank) || numberofkills >= required_kills) return true;  //This a/c is allowed for this player due to # of kills 
11600:            if (this.mission.stb_restrictAircraftByKills && required_kills != -1)
11601:            {
11602:                if (numberofkills >= required_kills) return true;  //This a/c is allowed for this player due to # of kills 
11603:                else if (!this.mission.stb_restrictAircraftByRank) return false;  //Not allowed via #ofkills, but we still need to check ByRank if that is turned on.  Otherwise, we're done.
11604:            }

11609:

11611:                                                                                                           //Console.WriteLine("reqrank: {0}", required_rank);

11617:        public string StbRaa_ListOfAllowedAircraftForRank(int rank, int army)
11618:        {
11619:
11620:            Dictionary<string, int> allowedAircraftByRank = stbRaa_AllowedAircraftByRank_Red;
11621:            if (army == 2) allowedAircraftByRank = stbRaa_AllowedAircraftByRank_Blue;
11622:
11623:            string msg = "";
11624:            string rankname = this.mission.stb_StatRecorder.StbSr_RankNameFromInt(rank, army);
11625:            if (rankname == "") return ""; //if our rank is out of bounds etc we'll return ""
11626:
11627:            msg += rankname + ": ";
11628:
11629:            bool first = true;
11630:            foreach (KeyValuePair<string, int> entry in allowedAircraftByRank)
11631:            {
11632:                if (entry.Value > rank) continue;
11633:                if (!first) msg += ", ";
11634:                msg += entry.Key;
11635:                first = false;
11636:            }
11637:            return msg;
11638:
11639:        }

11679:            Dictionary<string, int> allowedAircraftByRank = stbRaa_AllowedAircraftByRank_Red;
11680:            if (army == 2) allowedAircraftByRank = stbRaa_AllowedAircraftByRank_Blue;
11681:            string msg = "";

11684:
11685:            msg += rankname + ": ";
11686:
11687:            bool first = true;
11688:            foreach (KeyValuePair<string, int> entry in allowedAircraftByRank)
11689:            {
11690:                if (entry.Value != rank) continue;
11691:                if (!first) msg += ", ";
11692:                msg += entry.Key;
11693:                first = false;
11694:            }
11695:            if (!first) return msg;
11696:            else return StbRaa_ListOfAllowedAircraftForNextRank(rank, army); //little recursion here, but it will always eventually exit bec. we check for out of bounds on the dictionary at each step.  So it will eventually hit a rank that has something to report, or go out of bounds and return ""

11902:    //TODO: Better than doing this here, each & every time a particular stat is saved or accessed, would be to set this 
11903:    //whenever a player goes through 'placeenter'.  Save the players current fighter/bomber status in a dictionary & then look
11904:    //it up here as needed.  The problem that will solve, is what happens to a player's stats when they are killed or kicked
11905:    //out of a plane or just leave the place.  Under this system here, the second they leave the place/aircraft ALL stats
11906:    //& data will start flowing back to their main career rather than their bomber career.  This probably means losing

11908:    public string StbSr_MassagePlayername(string playerName, AiActor actor = null)//p[0]=NamedDamageTypeNo,p[1]=DamageType
11909:    {
11910:        string newPlayerName = playerName;
11911:        string careerTypes = mission.stb_getPilotTypeString(playerName);
11912:        //Console.WriteLine("StbSR_MassagePlayername: " + playerName + " " + careerTypes);
11913:
11914:
11915:        if (playerName.Contains("||PLAYER DIED"))
11916:        {
11917:
11918:            string ts = playerName.Substring(14); //chop off "||PLAYER DIED"
11919:                                                  //entry.Key.Substring()                              
11920:            string deathDate = ts.Substring(0, ts.IndexOf(" || "));
11921:            string name = ts.Substring(ts.IndexOf(" || ") + 4);
11922:
11923:            string selfKill = "";
11924:            if (name.Contains(" (self-kill)"))
11925:                selfKill = " (self-kill)";
11926:            name = name.Replace(" (self-kill)", "");
11927:
11928:            newPlayerName = "||PLAYER DIED " + deathDate + " || " + name + careerTypes + selfKill;
11929:
11930:        }
11931:        else
11932:        {
11933:            newPlayerName = playerName + careerTypes;
11934:        }
11935:
11936:        return newPlayerName;
11937:    }

12099:    public void StbSr_UpdateStatsForKilledPlayer(string playerName, int[] p, AiActor actor) //p[0]=KillType - 1 = normal, 2 = self-kill
12100:    {
12101:        try
12102:        {
12103:            playerName = StbSr_MassagePlayername(playerName, actor);
12104:
12105:            int[] temp = new int[stbSr_numStats];
12106:            //StbSr_WriteLine("FKP1: {0} {1} ", playerName, p[0]);
12107:
12108:            //If already on the deadplayers list we avoid doing all this "update stats for a dead pilot" routine.
12109:            //  The deadplayers list is a list of players who have died recently.
12110:            //  The idea is to avoid multiple kills being recorded to the same player
12111:            //for the same death.  Also it stops players who are already in "death timeout" from having any further deaths recorded AND ALSO
12112:            //from having their just-saved dead-pilot stats overwritten by a new (empty) dead pilot stats             
12113:            //ALSO (if the dead pilot timeout is in effect) it allows any activity/kills from the deceased pilot's last action to finish playing out &
12114:            //be recorded under their old stats (rather than under their new pilot stat)
12115:            if (StbSr_IsInDeadPlayers(playerName) == null && !playerName.Contains("||PLAYER DIED"))
12116:            {
12117:                //The logic is convoluted here because this can be called several times/recursively almost. If we are NOT resetting player stats
12118:                //on death then we just add their playerName to the deadplayers list & detect it that way.  But if we ARE resetting player 
12119:                //stats then the next death notice for that player will hit the enqueuetask method first and be replaced by "||PLAYER DIED blahblahblah 
12120:                //playerName".  So, we have to look for "||PLAYER DIED", too, and skip any further death-related piling on
12121:                //for this poor player--who, it turns out, is already quite dead and doesn't need to be killed again.
12122:
12123:                //If stbSr_ResetPlayerStatsWhenKilled then we're going to save the old stats entry with a new name (key)
12124:                //indicating the time & manner of death, thus resetting the person's stats
12125:                //If NOT stbSr_ResetPlayerStatsWhenKilled then the new name is just the same as the existing name.  
12126:                //We do this up here because we need the new dead pilot name for the DeadPlayers entry.  But we can't make new blank stats entry
12127:                //for the pilot until we've updated the existing stats entry etc etc etc
12128:                //StbSr_WriteLine("FKP2: {0} {1} ", playerName, p[0]);
12129:                string date, newplayerName;
12130:                if (stbSr_ResetPlayerStatsWhenKilled)
12131:                {
12132:                    //When a player is killed, just rename their existing stats/dictionary key to something indicated that player is dead now.
12133:                    date = DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("u").Replace(":", "."); // ":" is the escape character in the stats.txt save file, so we can have it in strings but it is a bit awkward looking; we'll just leave it out
12134:                    newplayerName = "||PLAYER DIED " + date + " || " + playerName;
12135:                    if (p[0] == 2) newplayerName += " (self-kill)";
12136:                    //Now we have the name - we'll actually rename the Dictionary entry later
12137:                }
12138:                else
12139:                {
12140:                    newplayerName = playerName; //If reset player stats on death is off, we just retain the existing playername for the deadplayers list
12141:                }
12142:
12143:
12144:                //If stb_PlayerTimeoutWhenKilled is SET, When player dies, add new name & time the timeout expires, to a stack we will check whenever adding new stats
12145:                //Thus the stats during the death timeout will go to the dead pilot career, not the new pilot career
12146:                //If stb_PlayerTimeoutWhenKilled is NOT SET, we still add it to the stack for a few seconds.  Reason is, CloD typically
12147:                //sends at least two "death notices" for the player in quick succession (plane killed, pilot killed, maybe even more in case of 
12148:                //multi-crew a/c.  So this avoids double-entering the death for the same player.
12149:                //Also it solves an issue with the -stats.cs module where the time of death is only saved with resolution of one second.
12150:                //So if two deaths occur within one second one of the prior lives will be overwritten.
12151:                DateTime currTime_plusTimeOut;
12152:                if (this.mission.stb_PlayerTimeoutWhenKilled) currTime_plusTimeOut = DateTime.Now.AddHours(this.mission.stb_PlayerTimeoutWhenKilledDuration_hours);
12153:                else currTime_plusTimeOut = DateTime.Now.AddSeconds(5);
12154:
12155:                var a = new Tuple<string, DateTime>(newplayerName, currTime_plusTimeOut);
12156:                stbSr_DeadPlayers.Add(playerName, a);
12157:
12158:
12159:                //First add one death to the stats.
12160:                if (!stbSr_AllPlayerStats.TryGetValue(playerName, out temp))
12161:                {
12162:                    temp = new int[stbSr_numStats];
12163:                }
12164:
12165:                //The system seems to report deaths twice in case of self kills (once as 'regular' and once as 'self'). So we only count death++ when it is NOT a self-kill to avoid double counting.
12166:                if (p[0] == 1) temp[778]++; //temp[778]=Deaths
12167:                if (p[0] == 2) temp[789]++; //temp[789]=Self-Kills         
12168:                temp[795] = StatCalcs.TimeSince2016_sec(); //record time of player death
12169:
12170:                stbSr_AllPlayerStats[playerName] = temp;
12171:
12172:                //StbSr_WriteLine("FKP3: {0} {1} ", playerName, newplayerName);
12173:                //OK, NOW we can change the player's stats entry key to its new name, if that option is enabled
12174:                if (stbSr_ResetPlayerStatsWhenKilled)
12175:                {
12176:                    StbSr_Calc_AceAndRank_ByName(playerName, actor);
12177:
12178:                    //int totalkills = StbSR_TotalKills(stbSr_AllPlayerStats[playerName]);
12179:
12180:
12181:
12182:                    //And, initiate a new stats which so far only shows the player's time of last death
12183:                    int[] temp2 = new int[stbSr_numStats];
12184:
12185:                    //transfer over a few key values:
12186:                    temp2[824] = stbSr_AllPlayerStats[playerName][824] + StbSR_TotalKills(stbSr_AllPlayerStats[playerName]); //prev accumulated total kills plus thos from the current life added to new life
12187:                    temp2[823] = Math.Max(stbSr_AllPlayerStats[playerName][797], stbSr_AllPlayerStats[playerName][823]); //max of current rank & prev highest rank
12188:                                                                                                                         //add total kill point, full victory, shared victory, assist totals from this life to the previous life accumulations
12189:                                                                                                                         //& save them in the new life as "previous life totals"
12190:                    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
12191:                    {
12192:                        temp2[825 + i] = stbSr_AllPlayerStats[playerName][825 + i] + stbSr_AllPlayerStats[playerName][798 + i];
12193:                    }
12194:
12195:                    temp2[795] = StatCalcs.TimeSince2016_sec(); //record time of player death
12196:
12197:                    //Don't change the keyname until we're done reading everything  from it!  Durr!!!
12198:                    StatCalcs.changeKey(stbSr_AllPlayerStats, playerName, newplayerName);
12199:
12200:                    stbSr_AllPlayerStats[playerName] = temp2;
12201:                    //Don't use WriteLine in the 2nd thread . . . kills everything silently, weird
12202:                    //StbSr_WriteLine("FKP: {0} {1} ", playerName, newplayerName);
12203:
12204:                    //StbSr_WriteLine("FKP4: {0} {1} ", playerName, newplayerName);
12205:                    StbSr_Calc_AceAndRank_ByName(playerName, actor);
12206:                }
12207:            }
12208:
12209:        }
12210:        catch (Exception ex) { StbSr_PrepareErrorMessage(ex); }
12211:    }

12322:    {
12323:        try
12324:        {
12325:            if (stbSr_LogStats)
12326:            {
12327:                FileInfo fi = new FileInfo(stbSr_PlayerStatsPathTxt);
12328:                if (fi.Exists)
12329:                {
12330:                    //if (TWCComms.Communicator.Instance.WARP_CHECK) StbSr_AlwaysWriteLine("SXX1 " + DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("T")); //testing disk output for warps
12331:                    StreamReader sr = File.OpenText(stbSr_PlayerStatsPathTxt);
12332:                    string s = sr.ReadToEnd();
12333:                    sr.Close();
12334:                    if (s == null) return;
12335:                    if (s == "") return;
12336:                    string[] retrievedStrings = s.Split(new string[] { ";" }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
12337:                    foreach (string retrievedStr in retrievedStrings)
12338:                    {
12339:                        StbSr_UpdateSingleUserStat(StatCalcs.unescapeSemicolon(retrievedStr));
12340:                    }
12341:                }
12342:                StbSr_Calc_All_AceAndRank();
12343:            }
12344:        }
12345:        catch (Exception ex) { StbSr_PrepareErrorMessage(ex); }
12346:    }

13673:                {
13674:                    //So we have been having an issue where player stats are lost bec the stats file write is interrupted somehow
13675:                    //Then only part of the file is written and everything after that point is lost.
13676:                    //To solve this problem, we now write to a stbSr_PlayerStatsPathTxt + ".tmp" file

13679:                    //End result is that we will end up with two backup file for each date.

13708:
13709:
13710:
13711:                    }
13712:
13713:                    //StbSr_WriteLine("Stats: times: " + System.IO.File.GetLastWriteTime(backupTxtFile2) + " " + dt.AddHours(-12) + " " + DateTime.Compare(System.IO.File.GetLastWriteTime(backupTxtFile2), dt.AddHours(-12)).ToString());

13794:        public void StbSr_SavePlayerStatsStringToFileFull(int[] p)
13795:        {
13796:            try
13797:            {
13798:
13799:                //We delete this file before starting to write the data to the .tmp file
13800:                //Then we create the file again when complete
13801:                //Thus, later, we can use the existence of this file as an indication
13802:                //that the .tmp file has been successfully & completely written 
13803:                try
13804:                {
13805:                    System.IO.File.Delete(stbSr_PlayerStatsPathTxt + ".completeflag");
13806:                }
13807:                catch (Exception ex) { StbSr_PrepareErrorMessage(ex, "stbsr_completeflag_delete"); }
13808:
13809:                if (stbSr_LogStats)
13810:                {
13811:                    if (stbSr_AllPlayerStats.Count == 0) return;
13812:                    //StbSr_WriteLine("Stats: Writing stats file to hard drive.");
13813:
13814:                    int currTime_sec = StatCalcs.TimeSince2016_sec();
13815:
13816:
13817:                    //if (TWCComms.Communicator.Instance.WARP_CHECK) StbSr_AlwaysWriteLine("SXX3 " + DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("T")); //testing disk output for warps
13818:                int numLines = (int)Math.Ceiling((stbSr_numStats / (double)50)); //numStats should be a mult of 50 but we round up here just in case.
13819:                    using (StreamWriter sw = new StreamWriter(stbSr_PlayerStatsPathTxt + ".tmp", false, System.Text.Encoding.UTF8))
13820:                    {
13821:                        foreach (KeyValuePair<string, int[]> entry in stbSr_AllPlayerStats)
13822:                        {
13823:                            //TODO: time to drop stats should be settable in stats.ini file
13824:                            if (entry.Value[829] > 0 && (currTime_sec - entry.Value[829]) > 60 * 60 * 24 * 120) continue; //drop any stats more than 120 days old TODO: Should be set in stats.ini
13825:                            if (entry.Value[797] < 4 && entry.Value[829] > 0 && (currTime_sec - entry.Value[829]) > 60 * 60 * 24 * 30) continue; //drop any stats more than 30 days old if rank is very low TODO: Should be set in stats.ini
13826:
13827:                        /* //The old way of writing out the stats, inflexible
13828:                        sw.Write(";" + Calcs.escapeSemicolon(Calcs.escapeColon(entry.Key)) + ":");
13829:                        sw.WriteLine();
13830:                        for (int j = 0; j < 15; j++)
13831:                        {
13832:                            for (int i = 0; i < 50; i++)
13833:                            {
13834:                                sw.Write(entry.Value[i + (j * 50)].ToString());
13835:                                sw.Write(",");
13836:                            }
13837:                            sw.WriteLine();
13838:                        }
13839:                        for (int k = 750; k < 800; k++)
13840:                        {
13841:                            sw.Write(entry.Value[k].ToString());
13842:                            sw.Write(",");
13843:                        }
13844:                        sw.WriteLine();
13845:                        */
13846:
13847:                        sw.Write(";" + StatCalcs.escapeSemicolon(StatCalcs.escapeColon(entry.Key)) + ":");
13848:                            sw.WriteLine();
13849:                            for (int j = 0; j < numLines; j++)
13850:                            {
13851:                                for (int i = 0; i < 50; i++)
13852:                                {
13853:                                    if (i + (j * 50) < stbSr_numStats) sw.Write(entry.Value[i + (j * 50)].ToString() + ",");   //(i + (j * 50)< stbSr_numStats) is a failsafe in case stbSr_numStats by chance is not a multiple of 50.                                      
13854:                                }
13855:                                sw.WriteLine();
13856:                            }
13857:                        }
13858:                    }
13859:                }
13860:
13861:                try
13862:                {
13863:                    System.IO.File.Create(stbSr_PlayerStatsPathTxt + ".completeflag").Close();
13864:                }
13865:                catch (Exception ex) { StbSr_PrepareErrorMessage(ex, "stbsr_completeflag_create"); }
13866:
13867:            }
13868:            catch (Exception ex)
13869:            {
13870:                StbSr_PrepareErrorMessage(ex, "stbsr_spss");
13871:                //if we get any kind of error in this routine, we just delete the (possibly/probably) incomplete .tmp file
13872:                //Thus any incomplete tmp files are not propagated down into the backups
13873:                try
13874:                {
13875:                    System.IO.File.Delete(stbSr_PlayerStatsPathTxt + ".tmp");
13876:                }
13877:                catch (Exception ex1) { StbSr_PrepareErrorMessage(ex1, "stbsr_deleting_tmp_file"); }
13878:
13879:            }
13880:        }

13922:            {
13923:

14463:                        sw.WriteLine("<h3>Raw Damage Points</h3><p><b>'Raw Damage Points' (RDPs)</b> are the one exception to the general rule that damage counts don't factor in damage severity. Raw Damage Points <i>are</i> scaled according to an assessment of the damage each hit caused. For that reason, RDPs are a very good assessment of how hard you are hitting the enemy.   RDPs work this way:  For every hit you make on an enemy object, which eventually leads to a kill, CloD assesses a damage value which is larger or smaller depending in the strength or potential damage of the hit. The Kill Point system works by adding up all of these individual RDP values for one particular kill and then setting that Kill Total to 1.  So if it took 50,000 RDPs to down an enemy and you contributed 25,000 of them, you are award 0.5 Kill Points.</p><p>Raw Damage Points simply total all of these Raw Damage Points without further refining or proportioning them. Total Raw Damage Points are given and in addition, to help bomber pilots track their progress, Raw Damage Points from bombing missions are broken out separately.</p>");

14973:
14974:public bool StbSr_UploadSSL(string ftpServer, string username, string password, string filename = null, bool isText = true)
14975:    {
14976:        //Console.WriteLine("StbSr_UploadSSL starting: {0} {1} {2} {3} {4}", ftpServer, username, password, filename, isText);
14977:        // 1. Move validation to the top
14978:        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(filename))
14979:        {
14980:            Console.WriteLine("StbSr_UploadSSL ERROR: Source filename missing.");
14981:            return false;
14982:        }
14983:
14984:        if (!File.Exists(filename))
14985:        {
14986:            Console.WriteLine("StbSr_UploadSSL ERROR: File does not exist at {0}", filename);
14987:            return false;
14988:        }
14989:
14990:        try
14991:        {
14992:            // Parse the ftpServer URI to get host, port, and remote path.
14993:            // The stats.ini still stores ftp:// URIs, but we connect via SFTP (SSH.NET).
14994:            Uri serverUri = new Uri(ftpServer);
14995:            if (serverUri.Scheme != Uri.UriSchemeFtp)
14996:            {
14997:                Console.WriteLine("StbSr_UploadSSL ERROR: ftpServer URI must start with 'ftp'");
14998:                return false;
14999:            }
15000:
15001:            string host = serverUri.Host;
15002:            int port = 22; // SFTP default port
15003:            if (!serverUri.IsDefaultPort)
15004:            {
15005:                port = serverUri.Port;
15006:            }
15007:            string remotePath = serverUri.AbsolutePath;
15008:            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(remotePath))
15009:            {
15010:                remotePath = "/";
15011:            }
15012:            // SFTP sends the remote path to the server literally.  Uri.AbsolutePath preserves
15013:            // percent-encoding (e.g. %20), but the remote SFTP server expects the actual space
15014:            // character - matching the legacy FTP behavior where the FTP server decoded %20.
15015:            // Decode so %20 etc. become real characters in the stored filename.
15016:            remotePath = Uri.UnescapeDataString(remotePath);
15017:
15018:            Console.WriteLine("SFTP UPLOAD: host={0} port={1} remotePath={2} localFile={3}", host, port, remotePath, filename);
15019:
15020:            // ---- Everything below runs under one lock so a single SFTP connection is
15021:            //      reused, uploads are throttled, and failures back off. ----
15022:            lock (stb_SftpLock)
15023:            {
15024:                // Throttle: if another upload just happened, wait before this one.
15025:                if (stb_SftpLastUpload != DateTime.MinValue)
15026:                {
15027:                    TimeSpan sinceLast = DateTime.Now - stb_SftpLastUpload;
15028:                    if (sinceLast < stb_SftpMinDelayBetweenUploads)
15029:                    {
15030:                        int sleepMs = (int)(stb_SftpMinDelayBetweenUploads.TotalMilliseconds - sinceLast.TotalMilliseconds);
15031:                        if (sleepMs > 0)
15032:                        {
15033:                            Thread.Sleep(sleepMs);
15034:                        }
15035:                    }
15036:                }
15037:                stb_SftpLastUpload = DateTime.Now;
15038:
15039:                // Backoff: if connect/login recently failed, do not retry yet.
15040:                if (DateTime.Now < stb_SftpBackoffUntil)
15041:                {
15042:                    Console.WriteLine("SFTP UPLOAD: skipped - in backoff cooldown {0}", filename);
15043:                    return false;
15044:                }
15045:
15046:                // Reuse existing connection if still open.
15047:                if (stb_SftpClient != null && stb_SftpClient.IsConnected)
15048:                {
15049:                    stb_SftpConnected = true;
15050:                }
15051:                else
15052:                {
15053:                    // Throttle reconnect attempts so we do not hammer the remote host.
15054:                    if ((DateTime.Now - stb_SftpLastConnectAttempt).TotalSeconds < stb_SftpConnectBackoff.TotalSeconds)
15055:                    {
15056:                        Console.WriteLine("SFTP UPLOAD: skipped - reconnect throttled {0}", filename);
15057:                        return false;
15058:                    }
15059:
15060:                    // Dispose any dead/disconnected client before creating a fresh one.
15061:                    if (stb_SftpClient != null)
15062:                    {
15063:                        try
15064:                        {
15065:                            if (stb_SftpClient.IsConnected)
15066:                            {
15067:                                stb_SftpClient.Disconnect();
15068:                            }
15069:                        }
15070:                        catch
15071:                        {
15072:                        }
15073:                        stb_SftpClient.Dispose();
15074:                        stb_SftpClient = null;
15075:                    }
15076:
15077:                    stb_SftpLastConnectAttempt = DateTime.Now;
15078:
15079:                    try
15080:                    {
15081:                        SftpClient sftp = new SftpClient(host, port, username, password);
15082:                        sftp.Connect();
15083:                        stb_SftpClient = sftp;
15084:                        stb_SftpConnected = true;
15085:                    }
15086:                    catch (Exception ex)
15087:                    {
15088:                        Console.WriteLine("StbSr_UploadSSL connect ERROR: {0}", ex.ToString());
15089:                        stb_SftpConnected = false;
15090:                        stb_SftpBackoffUntil = DateTime.Now + stb_SftpConnectBackoff;
15091:                        if (stb_SftpClient != null)
15092:                        {
15093:                            try { stb_SftpClient.Dispose(); } catch { }
15094:                            stb_SftpClient = null;
15095:                        }
15096:                        StbSr_PrepareErrorMessage(ex, "uploadSSL");
15097:                        return false;
15098:                    }
15099:                }
15100:
15101:                SftpClient sftp = stb_SftpClient;
15102:
15103:                try
15104:                {
15105:                    // Read file payload into memory
15106:                    byte[] fileContents = null;
15107:                    if (isText)
15108:                    {
15109:                        fileContents = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(File.ReadAllText(filename));
15110:                    }
15111:                    else
15112:                    {
15113:                        fileContents = File.ReadAllBytes(filename);
15114:                    }
15115:
15116:                    // Upload the stream to the remote path (canOverride = true)
15117:                    using (MemoryStream inputStream = new MemoryStream(fileContents))
15118:                    {
15119:                        sftp.UploadFile(inputStream, remotePath, true);
15120:                    }
15121:
15122:                    Console.WriteLine("SFTP UPLOAD: success {0}", filename);
15123:                    return true;
15124:                }
15125:                catch (Exception ex)
15126:                {
15127:                    Console.WriteLine("StbSr_UploadSSL WebException ERROR: {0}", ex.ToString());
15128:                    // Mark connection dead so next call creates a fresh one, and start backoff.
15129:                    stb_SftpConnected = false;
15130:                    stb_SftpBackoffUntil = DateTime.Now + stb_SftpConnectBackoff;
15131:                    if (stb_SftpClient != null)
15132:                    {
15133:                        try { stb_SftpClient.Dispose(); } catch { }
15134:                        stb_SftpClient = null;
15135:                    }
15136:                    StbSr_PrepareErrorMessage(ex, "uploadSSL");
15137:                    return false;
15138:                }
15139:            } // end lock
15140:        }
15141:        catch (Exception ex)
15142:        {
15143:            Console.WriteLine("StbSr_UploadSSL WebException ERROR: {0}", ex.ToString());
15144:            StbSr_PrepareErrorMessage(ex, "uploadSSL");
15145:            return false;
15146:        }
15147:    }

15175:        //Checks DeadPlayers & if name is in it, returns the replacement name that should be used instead (the "dead player name")
15176:        //If name is NOT in it then or the DeadPlayer time has expired, remove the expired deadplayer from the Dictionary if needed & return the null string
15177:        public String StbSr_IsInDeadPlayers(string playername)
15178:        {
15179:        //StbSr_WriteLine("IsInDeadPlayers: {0}", name);
15180:
15181:        //We need to ban BOTH the main player & the "bomber" & "strike" version, and return WHICHEVER may be in the dead pilots list.
15182:        //This little routine should be separated out into a function; used twice.
15183:        string playerBomberFighter = " (bomber)";
15184:        if (playername.EndsWith(playerBomberFighter)) playername.Remove(playername.Length - 9, 9);
15185:        string playerStrikeFighter = " (strike)";
15186:        if (playername.EndsWith(playerStrikeFighter)) playername.Remove(playername.Length - 9, 9);
15187:
15188:        string[] names = new string[] { playername, playername + playerBomberFighter, playername + playerStrikeFighter };
15189:
15190:        foreach (string n in names)
15191:            {
15192:                Tuple<string, DateTime> temp;
15193:                if (stbSr_DeadPlayers.TryGetValue(n, out temp))
15194:                {
15195:                    DateTime now = DateTime.Now;
15196:                    //StbSr_WriteLine("IsInDeadPlayers: {0} {1} {2} {3}", name, temp.Item1.ToString(), now, temp.Item2);
15197:                    if (now < temp.Item2) return temp.Item1; //if the player is in the dead players list & the timeout is not yet expired, then replace the player name with the dead player name
15198:                    else
15199:                    {
15200:                        stbSr_DeadPlayers.Remove(playername); //if the player isn the dead players list & the timeout is expired, just remove that person from the list
15201:                        return null;
15202:                    }
15203:                }
15204:
15205:            }
15206:            return null;
15207:        }

15222:        void StbSr_Work()
15223:        {
15224:            while (true)
15225:            {
15226:                StatsMission.StbStatTask task = new StatsMission.StbStatTask(StatsMission.StbStatCommands.None, "", new int[] { 0 });
15227:                lock (stbSr_Locker)
15228:                    if (stbSr_Tasks.Count > 0)
15229:                    {
15230:                        task = stbSr_Tasks.Dequeue();
15231:                        if (task.command == StatsMission.StbStatCommands.None) return;
15232:                    }
15233:                if (task.command != StatsMission.StbStatCommands.None)
15234:                {
15235:                    switch (task.command)
15236:                    {
15237:                        case StatsMission.StbStatCommands.Damage:
15238:                            StbSr_UpdateStatsForDamage(task.player, task.parameters, task.actor);
15239:                            break;
15240:                        case StatsMission.StbStatCommands.Dead:
15241:                            StbSr_UpdateStatsForDead(task.player, task.parameters, task.actor);
15242:                            break;
15243:                        case StatsMission.StbStatCommands.PlayerKilled:
15244:                            StbSr_UpdateStatsForKilledPlayer(task.player, task.parameters, task.actor);
15245:                            break;
15246:                        case StatsMission.StbStatCommands.Mission:
15247:                            StbSr_UpdateStatsForMission(task.player, task.parameters, task.actor);
15248:                            break;
15249:                        case StatsMission.StbStatCommands.CutLimb:
15250:                            StbSr_UpdateStatsForCutLimb(task.player, task.parameters, task.actor);
15251:                            break;
15252:                        case StatsMission.StbStatCommands.TaskCurrent:
15253:                            StbSr_UpdateStatsForTaskCurrent(task.player, task.parameters, task.actor);
15254:                            break;
15255:                        case StatsMission.StbStatCommands.Save:
15256:                            StbSr_SavePlayerStats(task.parameters);
15257:                            break;
15258:                        default:
15259:                            break;
15260:                    }
15261:                }
15262:                else
15263:                    stbSr_Wh.WaitOne();
15264:            }
15265:        }

15270:            StbSr_EnqueueTask(t);// Signal to exit.
15271:            stbSr_Worker.Join();// Wait for the thread to finish.
15272:            stbSr_Wh.Close();// Release resources.

15327:        public static bool changeKey<TKey, TValue>(this IDictionary<TKey, TValue> dict, TKey oldKey, TKey newKey)
15328:        {
15329:            TValue value;
15330:            if (!dict.TryGetValue(oldKey, out value))
15331:                return false;
15332:
15333:            dict.Remove(oldKey);  // do not change order
15334:            dict[newKey] = value;  // or dict.Add(newKey, value) depending on ur comfort
15335:            return true;

15338:        //gets LAST occurence of any element of a specified string[] ; CASE INSENSITIVE
15339:        public static int LastIndexOfAny(string test, string[] values)
15340:        {
15341:            int last = -1;
15342:            test = test.ToLower();
15343:            foreach (string item in values)
15344:            {
15345:                int i = test.IndexOf(item.ToLower());
15346:                if (i >= 0)
15347:                {
15348:                    if (last > 0)
15349:                    {
15350:                        if (i > last)
15351:                        {
15352:                            last = i;
15353:                        }
15354:                    }
15355:                    else
15356:                    {
15357:                        last = i;
15358:                    }
15359:                }
15360:            }
15361:            return last;
15362:        }

15421:        public static double CalculateGradientAngle(
15422:                                  Point3d startPoint,
15423:                                  Point3d endPoint)
15424:        {
15425:            //Calculate the length of the adjacent and opposite
15426:            double diffX = endPoint.x - startPoint.x;
15427:            double diffY = endPoint.y - startPoint.y;
15428:
15429:            //Calculates the Tan to get the radians (TAN(alpha) = opposite / adjacent)
15430:            //Math.PI/2 - atan becase we need to change to bearing where North =0, East = 90 vs regular math coordinates where East=0 and North=90.
15431:            double radAngle = Math.PI / 2 - Math.Atan2(diffY, diffX);
15432:
15433:            //Converts the radians in degrees
15434:            double degAngle = RadiansToDegrees(radAngle);
15435:
15436:            if (degAngle < 0)
15437:            {
15438:                degAngle = degAngle + 360;
15439:            }
15440:
15441:            return degAngle;
15442:        }

15451:            return (int)degrees;
15452:        }

15493:        public static double CalculateBearingDegree(Vector3d vector)
15494:        {
15495:            Vector2d matVector = new Vector2d(vector.y, vector.x);
15496:            // the value of direction is in rad so we need *180/Pi to get the value in degrees.  We subtract from pi/2 to convert to compass directions
15497:
15498:            double bearing = (matVector.direction()) * 180.0 / Math.PI;
15499:            return (bearing > 0.0 ? bearing : (360.0 + bearing));
15500:        }

15503:        public static double CalculateBearingDegree(Vector2d vector)
15504:        {
15505:            Vector2d newVector = new Vector2d(vector.y, vector.x);
15506:            // the value of direction is in rad so we need *180/Pi to get the value in degrees.  We subtract from pi/2 to convert to compass directions
15507:            double bearing = (newVector.direction()) * 180.0 / Math.PI;
15508:            return (bearing > 0.0 ? bearing : (360.0 + bearing));  //we want bearing to be 0-360, generally
15509:        }

15511:        public static double CalculatePitchDegree(Vector3d vector)
15512:        {
15513:            double d = distance(vector.x, vector.y);  //size of vector in x/y plane
15514:            Vector2d matVector = new Vector2d(d, vector.z);
15515:            // the value of direction is in rad so we need *180/Pi to get the value in degrees.  
15516:
15517:            double pitch = (matVector.direction()) * 180.0 / Math.PI;
15518:            return (pitch < 180 ? pitch : (pitch - 360.0)); //we want pitch to be between -180 and 180, generally
15519:        }

15553:                if (sec < 10 * 60) return timespan.ToString(@"m\mss\s");
15554:                if (sec < 60 * 60) return timespan.ToString(@"m\m");
15555:                if (sec < 24 * 60 * 60) return timespan.ToString(@"hh\hmm\m");

15558:            catch (Exception ex)

15565:        //returns index of largest array element which is equal to OR less than the value
15566:        //assumes a sorted list of in values. 
15567:        //If less than the 1st element or array empty, returns -1
15568:        public static Int32 array_find_equalorless(int[] arr, Int32 value)
15569:        {
15570:            if (arr == null || arr.GetLength(0) == 0 || value < arr[0]) return -1;
15571:            int index = Array.BinarySearch(arr, value);
15572:            if (index < 0)
15573:            {
15574:                index = ~index - 1;
15575:            }
15576:            if (index < 0) return -1;
15577:            return index;
15578:        }

15580:        //Splits a long string into a maxLineLength respecting word boundaries (IF possible)
15581:        //http://stackoverflow.com/questions/22368434/best-way-to-split-string-into-lines-with-maximum-length-without-breaking-words
15582:        public static IEnumerable<string> SplitToLines(string stringToSplit, int maxLineLength)
15583:        {
15584:            string[] words = stringToSplit.Split(' ');
15585:            StringBuilder line = new StringBuilder();
15586:            foreach (string word in words)
15587:            {
15588:                if (word.Length + line.Length <= maxLineLength)
15589:                {
15590:                    line.Append(word + " ");
15591:                }
15592:                else
15593:                {
15594:                    if (line.Length > 0)
15595:                    {
15596:                        yield return line.ToString().Trim();
15597:                        line.Clear();
15598:                    }
15599:                    string overflow = word;
15600:                    while (overflow.Length > maxLineLength)
15601:                    {
15602:                        yield return overflow.Substring(0, maxLineLength);
15603:                        overflow = overflow.Substring(maxLineLength);
15604:                    }
15605:                    line.Append(overflow + " ");
15606:                }
15607:            }
15608:            yield return line.ToString().Trim();
15609:        }

15896:        /// <summary>
15897:        /// returns number of damages to aircraft
15898:        /// lists damages in server log info window
15899:        /// shows HUD messages & chat messages if desired
15900:    /// If player==null just returns # of damages to the given AiAircraft
15901:    /// messageOnlyIfDamaged = true shows messages only when damage is present & no message otherwise
15902:        /// </summary>
15903:    public static int listDamages(IGamePlay GamePlay, StatsMission statsmission, Player CurPlayer = null, bool bShowMessages = false, AiAircraft aircraft = null, bool bIsRefueling = false, bool messageOnlyIfDamaged=false)
15904:        {
15905:        int nDamages = 0;
15906:		int damageHits = 0;
15907:        try
15908:        {
15909:            AiAircraft PlayersAircraft = aircraft;
15910:            if (CurPlayer != null) PlayersAircraft = CurPlayer.Place() as AiAircraft;
15911:            if (PlayersAircraft == null) return 0; //nothing to do
15912:            if (CurPlayer == null) bShowMessages = false;
15913:
15914:            string[] PartNames = Enum.GetNames(typeof(part.NamedDamageTypes));
15915:            part.NamedDamageTypes[] PartVals = (part.NamedDamageTypes[])Enum.GetValues(typeof(part.NamedDamageTypes));
15916:            double dDamage = 0;
15917:
15918:            if (bShowMessages)
15919:            {
15920:                GamePlay.gpHUDLogCenter(new Player[] { CurPlayer }, "Checking aircraft for damage (See chat/server info window) ...");
15921:            }
15922:
15923:            for (int i = 0; i < PartNames.Length; i++)
15924:            {
15925:                try
15926:                {
15927:                    dDamage = PlayersAircraft.getParameter(part.ParameterTypes.M_NamedDamage, (int)(PartVals[i]));
15928:                    if (0 != dDamage)
15929:                    {
15930:                        if (bShowMessages || messageOnlyIfDamaged) GamePlay.gpLogServer(new Player[] { CurPlayer }, "Damage: " + PartNames[i], null);
15931:                        nDamages++;
15932:                    }
15933:                }
15934:                catch (IndexOutOfRangeException e)
15935:                {
15936:					if (bShowMessages || messageOnlyIfDamaged) GamePlay.gpLogServer(new Player[] { CurPlayer }, "Damage: " + PartNames[i], null);
15937:                }
15938:            }
15939:			
15940:			if (statsmission.aircraftDamageTotal.ContainsKey(PlayersAircraft) && statsmission.aircraftDamageTotal[PlayersAircraft] > 0) {
15941:				damageHits = statsmission.aircraftDamageTotal[PlayersAircraft];
15942:				if (bShowMessages || messageOnlyIfDamaged) GamePlay.gpLogServer(new Player[] { CurPlayer }, "Total Times Damaged: " + damageHits.ToString() , null);
15943:			}				
15944:
15945:            if (bShowMessages || messageOnlyIfDamaged)
15946:            {
15947:                if (bIsRefueling || messageOnlyIfDamaged)
15948:                {
15949:                    if (0 == nDamages && 0 == damageHits && bShowMessages)
15950:                    {
15951:                        GamePlay.gpHUDLogCenter(new Player[] { CurPlayer }, "No damage");
15952:                    }
15953:                    if  (nDamages > 0 && (bShowMessages || messageOnlyIfDamaged))
15954:                    {
15955:                        GamePlay.gpHUDLogCenter(new Player[] { CurPlayer }, "Your aircraft has damage: See chat/server info window.");
15956:                    }
15957:                }
15958:
15959:                if (nDamages + damageHits > 0 && ( bShowMessages || messageOnlyIfDamaged))
15960:                {
15961:                    if (bIsRefueling)
15962:                        GamePlay.gpLogServer(new Player[] { CurPlayer }, "Inspection complete. Your aircraft has " + nDamages.ToString() + " listed damaged parts and has been hit or damaged " + damageHits.ToString() + " times.  Continue with the refuel/rearm or exit and enter a new fully repaired aircraft--your choice. Continuing to refuel . . . ", null);
15963:                    else GamePlay.gpLogServer(new Player[] { CurPlayer }, "Aircraft inspection complete. Your aircraft has " + nDamages + " damaged parts.", null);
15964:                }
15965:                if (nDamages + damageHits == 0 && bShowMessages)
15966:                {
15967:                    if (bIsRefueling) GamePlay.gpLogServer(new Player[] { CurPlayer }, "Inspection complete. No damage found. Continuing to refuel . . . ", null);
15968:                    else GamePlay.gpLogServer(new Player[] { CurPlayer }, "Aircraft inspection complete. No damage found.", new Object[] { });
15969:                }
15970:            }
15971:        }
15972:        catch (Exception ex) { Console.WriteLine("statscalc listDamages() ERROR: " + ex.ToString());}
15973:		
15974:		//we return the greater of # of damaged parts (list) and how many damage hits recorded from OnAircraftDamaged
15975:		int retDamages = nDamages;
15976:		if (damageHits > retDamages) retDamages = damageHits;
15977:
15978:        return retDamages;
15979:    }

15981:        /// <summary>
15982:        /// returns true if all fuel cocks are closed
15983:        /// </summary>
15984:        public static bool hasClosedAllFuelCocks(IGamePlay GamePlay, Player CurPlayer)
15985:        {
15986:            bool bAllClosed = true;
15987:            AiAircraft PlayersAircraft = CurPlayer.Place() as AiAircraft;
15988:            double dPos = 0;
15989:
15990:            /// The G.50 cannot close fuelcock
15991:            if (PlayersAircraft.InternalTypeName().Contains("Aircraft.G50"))
15992:            {
15993:                if (StatCalcs.DEBUG_MESSAGES)
15994:                {
15995:                    GamePlay.gpLogServer(new Player[] { CurPlayer }, "Checking fuelcocks, G.50 has none", null);
15996:                }
15997:            }
15998:            else for (int i = 0; bAllClosed && i < StatCalcs.MAX_ENGINE_COUNT; i++)
15999:                {
16000:                    try
16001:                    {
16002:                        dPos = PlayersAircraft.getParameter(part.ParameterTypes.C_FuelTankSelector, i);
16003:
16004:                        if (StatCalcs.DEBUG_MESSAGES)
16005:                        {
16006:                            GamePlay.gpLogServer(new Player[] { CurPlayer }, "Checking fuelcocks, engine " + i + ": " + dPos, null);
16007:                        }
16008:
16009:                        /// Spitfire's values are reversed
16010:                        /// 0: ON, 1: OFF
16011:                        if (PlayersAircraft.InternalTypeName().Contains("Spitfire"))
16012:                        {
16013:                            if (1 != dPos) bAllClosed = false;
16014:                        }
16015:                        /// Ju 87 B-2 values are reversed, too
16016:                        /// 0: both, 1: left, 2: right, 3: close
16017:                        else if (PlayersAircraft.InternalTypeName().Contains("Ju-87"))
16018:                        {
16019:                            if (3 != dPos) bAllClosed = false;
16020:                        }
16021:                        /// All others have 0: OFF and 1,2,3: something not OFF
16022:                        else
16023:                        {
16024:                            if (0 != dPos) bAllClosed = false;
16025:                        }
16026:                    }
16027:                    /// nor more fuelcocks
16028:                    catch (IndexOutOfRangeException e)
16029:                    {
16030:                        if (i == 0 && StatCalcs.DEBUG_MESSAGES)
16031:                        {
16032:                            GamePlay.gpLogServer(new Player[] { CurPlayer }, "Exception at " + i, null);
16033:                        }
16034:                        break;
16035:                    }
16036:                }
16037:            return bAllClosed;
16038:        }

16041:        /// returns true if all magnetos are turned off
16042:        /// </summary>

16044:        {

16047:            string actype = (Calcs.GetAircraftType(PlayersAircraft)).ToLower();
16048:            if (actype.Contains("G50") || actype.Contains("D520")) return true;  //these don't have magnetos or something?
16049:
16050:            for (int i = 0; bAllOff && i < StatCalcs.MAX_ENGINE_COUNT; i++)
16051:            {
16052:                try
16053:                {
16054:                    double dVal = PlayersAircraft.getParameter(part.ParameterTypes.C_Magneto, i);
16055:
16056:                    if (StatCalcs.DEBUG_MESSAGES)
16057:                    {
16058:                        GamePlay.gpLogServer(new Player[] { CurPlayer }, "Checking magnetos, engine " + i + ": " + dVal, null);

16062:                    {
16063:                        bAllOff = false;
16064:                    }
16065:                }
16066:                /// No more magnetos
16067:                catch (IndexOutOfRangeException e)
16068:                {
16069:                    break;
16070:                }
16071:            }
16072:
16073:            return bAllOff;
16074:        }
