16108:    /********************************************************************************/
16109:    /* //Circular array is already in -main.cs, so this is redundant
16110:    //Circular array which operates as a limited size queue OR stack
16111:    //Based on https://www.codeproject.com/Articles/31652/A-Generic-Circular-Array
16112:    public class CircularArray<T>
16113:    {
16114:        private readonly T[] _baseArray;
16115:        private readonly T[] _facadeArray;
16116:        private int _head;
16117:        private bool _isFilled;
16118:
16119:        public CircularArray(int length)
16120:        {
16121:            _baseArray = new T[length];
16122:            _facadeArray = new T[length];
16123:        }
16124:
16125:        //Array in queue order (first queued = first of array)
16126:        public T[] Array
16127:        {
16128:            get
16129:            {
16130:                int pos = _head;
16131:                for (int i = 0; i < _baseArray.Length; i++)
16132:                {
16133:                    Math.DivRem(pos, _baseArray.Length, out pos);
16134:                    _facadeArray[i] = _baseArray[pos];
16135:                    pos++;
16136:                }
16137:                return _facadeArray;
16138:            }
16139:        }
16140:
16141:        //Array in stack order (last queued = first of array)
16142:        public T[] ArrayStack
16143:        {
16144:            get
16145:            {
16146:                int pos = _head - 1; // + 2*_baseArray.Length;  //by adding 2*_baseArray.Length we can count downwards by _baseArray.Length with no worries about going below 0 for our index.  We have to go 2* bec _head might be zero meaning our starting point might be -1
16147:                for (int i = 0; i < _baseArray.Length; i++)
16148:                {
16149:                    Math.DivRem(pos, _baseArray.Length, out pos);
16150:                    //Console.WriteLine("ArrayStack: " + i.ToString());
16151:                    _facadeArray[i] = _baseArray[pos];
16152:                    pos--;
16153:                    pos = pos < 0 ? pos + _baseArray.Length : pos;
16154:                }
16155:                return _facadeArray;
16156:            }
16157:        }
16158:
16159:        public T[] BaseArray
16160:        {
16161:            get { return _baseArray; }
16162:        }
16163:
16164:        public bool IsFilled
16165:        {
16166:            get { return _isFilled; }
16167:        }
16168:
16169:        public void Push(T value)
16170:        {
16171:            if (!_isFilled && _head == _baseArray.Length - 1)
16172:                _isFilled = true;
16173:
16174:            Math.DivRem(_head, _baseArray.Length, out _head);
16175:            _baseArray[_head] = value;
16176:            _head++;
16177:        }
16178:
16179:        //Gets end of queue (ie, the first value entered) if 0 or 2nd, 3rd, etc value entered if index 1, 2, 3 etc
16180:        //10/2018 - this seems incorrect. This gets the last value pushed onto the array if 0, 2nd to last if 1, etc.
16181:        public T Get(int indexBackFromHead)
16182:        {
16183:            int pos = _head - indexBackFromHead - 1;
16184:            pos = pos < 0 ? pos + _baseArray.Length : pos;
16185:            Math.DivRem(pos, _baseArray.Length, out pos);
16186:            return _baseArray[pos];
16187:        }
16188:
16189:        //Gets top of the stack (ie, the last value entered) if 0 or 2nd to last, 3rd to last, etc if index 1, 2, 3 etc 
16190:        ////10/2018 - this seems incorrect. This gets the tail of the array, ie the first value pushed onto the array (that still remains), ie the oldest value in the array, if 0, 2nd to last if 1, etc.
16191:        public T GetStack(int indexForwardFromHead)
16192:        {
16193:            int pos = _head + indexForwardFromHead;
16194:            pos = pos < 0 ? pos + _baseArray.Length : pos;
16195:            Math.DivRem(pos, _baseArray.Length, out pos);
16196:            return _baseArray[pos];
16197:        }
16198:    }
16199:    */

16239:    //StatsIniFile - -stats version
16240:    
16241:    namespace Ini
16242:    {
16243:        /// <summary>
16244:        /// Create a New INI file to store or load data
16245:        /// https://www.codeproject.com/Articles/1966/An-INI-file-handling-class-using-C
16246:        /// </summary>
16247:        public class StatsIniFile
16248:        {
16249:            public string path;
16250:            public StatsMission mission;
16251:            public int iniErrorCount;
16252:
16253:            [DllImport("kernel32")]
16254:            private static extern long WritePrivateProfileString(string section, string key, string val, string filePath);
16255:            [DllImport("kernel32")]
16256:            private static extern int GetPrivateProfileString(string section, string key, string def, StringBuilder retVal, int size, string filePath);
16257:
16258:            /// <summary>
16259:            /// INIFile Constructor.
16260:            /// </summary>
16261:            /// <param name="INIPath"></param>
16262:            public StatsIniFile(string INIPath, StatsMission msn)
16263:            {
16264:                path = INIPath;
16265:                mission = msn;
16266:                iniErrorCount = 0;
16267:
16268:            }
16269:            /// <summary>
16270:            /// Write Data to the INI File
16271:            /// </summary>
16272:            /// <param name="Section"></param>
16273:            /// Section name
16274:            /// <param name="Key"></param>
16275:            /// Key Name
16276:            /// <param name="Value"></param>
16277:            /// Value Name
16278:            public void IniWriteValue(string Section, string Key, string Value)
16279:            {
16280:                WritePrivateProfileString(Section, Key, Value, this.path);
16281:            }
16282:
16283:            /// <summary>
16284:            /// Read Data Value From the Ini File
16285:            /// </summary>
16286:            /// <param name="Section"></param>
16287:            /// <param name="Key"></param>
16288:            /// <param name="Path"></param>
16289:            /// <returns></returns>
16290:            //overloaded for string, int, double, bool.  Could do others like single, float, whatever.  String[] int[] double[] etc.
16291:            public string IniReadValue(string Section, string Key, string def)
16292:            {
16293:                StringBuilder temp = new StringBuilder(1024);
16294:                int i = GetPrivateProfileString(Section, Key, "", temp, 1024, this.path);
16295:                if (temp.Length > 0) return temp.ToString();
16296:                {
16297:                    IniReadError(Section, Key);
16298:                    return def;
16299:                }
16300:            }
16301:            public int IniReadValue(string Section, string Key, int def)
16302:            {
16303:                StringBuilder temp = new StringBuilder(1024);
16304:                int i = GetPrivateProfileString(Section, Key, "", temp, 1024, this.path);
16305:                int a;
16306:                if (temp.Length > 0 && int.TryParse(temp.ToString(), out a)) return a;
16307:                {
16308:                    IniReadError(Section, Key);
16309:                    return def;
16310:                }
16311:            }
16312:            public double IniReadValue(string Section, string Key, double def)
16313:            {
16314:                StringBuilder temp = new StringBuilder(1024);
16315:                int i = GetPrivateProfileString(Section, Key, "", temp, 1024, this.path);
16316:                double a;
16317:                if (temp.Length > 0 && double.TryParse(temp.ToString(), out a)) return a;
16318:                {
16319:                    IniReadError(Section, Key);
16320:                    return def;
16321:                }
16322:            }
16323:            public bool IniReadValue(string Section, string Key, bool def)
16324:            {
16325:                StringBuilder temp = new StringBuilder(1024);
16326:                int i = GetPrivateProfileString(Section, Key, "", temp, 1024, this.path);
16327:                if (temp.ToString().Trim() == "1") temp = new StringBuilder("True", 4); //allow 0 & 1 to be used, or True/true/False/false
16328:                if (temp.ToString().Trim() == "0") temp = new StringBuilder("False", 5);
16329:                bool a;
16330:                if (temp.Length > 0 && bool.TryParse(temp.ToString(), out a)) return a;
16331:                else
16332:                {
16333:                    IniReadError(Section, Key);
16334:                    return def;
16335:                }
16336:            }
16337:            private void IniReadError(String Section, String Key)
16338:            {
16339:                //broadcasting this a bit widely bec. .ini file error is quite serious
16340:                iniErrorCount++;
16341:                Console.WriteLine("-stats.cs: ERROR reading stats.ini file: Key {0} in Section {1} was not found. Using default value instead.", Key, Section);
16342:
16343:                mission.stb_iniFileErrorMessages += "-stats.cs: ERROR (#" + iniErrorCount.ToString() + ") reading stats.ini file: Key " + Key + " in Section " + Section + " was not found. Using default value instead.\n";
16344:                //The ideas below don't work - I think because it is just too early in program invocation.  Things are not initialized.
16345:                //maddox.game.IGamePlay.gpLogServer(null, "Error reading .ini file: Key {0} in Section {1} was not found. Using default value instead.", null);
16346:                //mission.Stb_Message(null, "Error reading .ini file: Key {0} in Section {1} was not found. Using default value instead.", new object [] { Key, Section });
16347:                //this.mission.Stb_Message(null, "Error reading .ini file: Key " + Key + " in Section " + Section +" was not found. Using default value instead.", null);
16348:
16349:            }
16350:        }
16351:    }
